{{Youmay|[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history|[[Galactic Timeline]], a series of [[in-universe]] videos, or [[Time Tales]], a fan-made ''[[Star Wars]]'' timeline initially launched in [[1996]]. You may also be looking for [[Wookieepedia]]'s [[timeline of Legends media]]}}
{{MultipleIssues|citation|cleanup|redlink|image}}
{{Quote|I don't think there's ever been a time in our recorded history when there wasn't a war going on somewhere.''"<br />"''All the more reason for changing the future, then.|Jacen Solo and Lumiya|<ref name="LotF: Bloodlines" />}}
This is a '''timeline of galactic history''' recording [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] important events. All dates are given according to the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

=Timeline of galactic history=
==[[Pre-Republic era]]==
*Dawn of [[Time/Legends|time]]
**The [[Big Bang]] occurs, creating the [[Universe/Legends|universe]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref>citation needed</ref>
*c. [[13,000,000,000 BBY]][[File:Galaxy1.png|thumb|right|300px|The galaxy is born from a cloud of dust and gas.]]
**[[The galaxy/Legends|The galaxy]] is formed from a cloud of dust and gas one hundred thousand light-years across, that experiences a gravitational collapse. Eventually, the cloud will coalesce into a disk of stars of the same dimensions orbiting around an extremely massive black hole.<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[7,500,000,000 BBY]]
**[[Hydrogen/Legends|Hydrogen]], [[Helium/Legends|Helium]] and interplanetary dust coalesce to form the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref>''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'' dates the formation of the Yavin system to more than 7,5 billion [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref>
*c. [[5,000,000,000 BBY]]
**Life emerges for the first time on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], the second planet of the [[Goroth system/Legends|Goroth system]].<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>
*c. [[10,000,000 BBY]]
**The planet [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] undergoes a period of high volcanic activity.<ref name="Into the Core">{{JournalCite|7|Into the Core Worlds}}</ref>
*c. [[3,000,000 BBY]]
**The planet [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] is struck by an asteroid that wipes out nearly all life on the planet. The survivors eventually evolve into the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Essential Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
*c. [[2,000,000 BBY]]
**The planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] reaches an evolutionary crux where species must learn to adapt or die. In this violent period, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species begins evolving, eventually becoming a species of tree-climbers.<ref name="Essential Alien" />
**The [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] species establishes a technological society on the low-gravity planet [[Columus/Legends|Columus]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>
*c. [[1,500,000 BBY]]
**Earliest known instance of the Wookiees on Kashyyyk playing [[Tree-drum music]] on [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]], a celebration of the planet's diverse ecosystem and the many forms of life it encompasses.<ref name="slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
*c. [[1,000,000 BBY]]
**An ancient aquatic civilization thrives on the planet [[Jerrilek]], but eventually goes extinct in the following millennia.<ref name="Loyalties">{{JournalCite|4|Loyalties}}</ref>
**The semi-intelligent ancestors to the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] emerge on Goroth Prime.<ref name="Goroth" />
*c. [[600,000 BBY]]
**By this point, the cephalopod-crustacean hybrids known as [[ibliton]] have evolved on [[Randorn 2]], leaving fossil records that are later analyzed by the [[Tyberious Institute of Xenobiology]] hundreds of thousands of years later.<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
*c. [[200,000 BBY]]
**On the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Notron]], which will be later known as Coruscant, a [[Zhell–Taung war|war]] is fought between the two native species for control of their world, the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]], who are theorized to be the ancient ancestors of the modern [[Human/Legends|humans]], and the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]].<ref name="Author's Cut 2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref> 
***According to the epic poem ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]'', the [[Battalions of Zhell]] and the Taungs armies fight for centuries. Eventually, the Taungs led by a General nicknamed the [[Doom of Ulmarah]] successfully take [[Great Zhell]], the Zhell capital, but with heavy losses, the General among them.<ref name="Author's Cut 2"/>[[File:Last_Stand_of_the_Taungs.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The last stand of the Taungs against the Batallions of Zhell.]]
***The Zhell besiege their occupied city and the Taungs, now led by [[Rexutu the Unconquerable]], resolve to make their last stand there. With the Taung defeat apparently imminent, a volcanic eruption brings devastation upon the thirteen Battalions of Zhell, nearly destroying their race. The enormous plume of ash and smoke is so dense and widespread across the sky that it blocks out the light from the sun, leaving the land beneath in darkness for two years. The Taungs immediately take advantage, and in the aftermath of the eruption they subjugate their enemy.<ref name="Author's Cut 2"/>
***The Taungs view the smoke and shadow as an emblem of their destiny, and adopt the name ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]'' for themselves, "Warriors of the Shadow" in the [[Mando'a/Legends|Taung language]]. However, the Zhell eventually manage to win back control of Notron and drive the Taungs from the planet.<ref name="Author's Cut 2"/>
***The defeated Taungs flee to [[Roon/Legends|Roon]], where they leave behind a number of artifacts that will be found by future archaeologists, as well as the text of ''Dha Werda Verda'' written in [[Roonstone]]s. The Taungs then begin a nomadic existence, roaming through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Author's Cut 2"/>
*c. [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]]
**Roughly around this time,<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] construct [[Centerpoint Station]] using the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> Using the station, they then build the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]] and its [[Cosmic Turbine]], the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], and the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Celestials also create [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] cluster in order to contain [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] entity known as [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
**The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] begin to develop a civilization on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
**The [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] species achieves interstellar spaceflight and surveys the "primitive" people of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] and Notron, known by that point as Coruscant. However, they are disappointed by the developing [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and Human civilizations and return to their homeworld of [[Columus/Legends|Columus]] in isolation.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
**Around this time, the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] expand out from the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]] and the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], planting their indestructible pyramids on planets such as [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. However, the Sharu bury their cities and revert to a primitive state in an attempt to avoid the Celestials' attention.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The winged [[thrantcill]]s are first recorded flying south for winter on Coruscant.<ref name="Cestus">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>
**The [[Muurshantre Extinction]] occurs, destroying the [[Taurannik Codex]] and scattering its remains.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
*c. [[90,000 BBY]]
**The metropolis eventually known as [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] has grown to the point where new levels are built atop old ones, beginning the trend of upward building that continues for millennia.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[57,000 BBY/Legends|57,000 BBY]]
**[[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] colonists arrive on the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. They will later evolve into the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] and [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] species.<ref name="New Essential Alien">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
*c. [[53,600 BBY]]
**The [[Quake]], a series of intense [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that last for centuries, begins on the planet [[Quesh]].<ref name="Quake">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Quake}}</ref>
*c. [[53,300 BBY]]
**The Quake comes to an end as Quesh becomes geologically stable.<ref name="Quake" />
*c. [[37,453 BBY]]
**The [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu]] monks of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] discover a half-buried pyramidal starship they christen the "[[Tho Yor]]." The monks start attending the Tho Yor through meditation.<ref name="BenduThoYor">In [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]], it is said that the Bendu monks attended the Tho Yor for a millennium before they finally heard its call, which occurred in [[36,453 BBY]] according to [[John Ostrander]].</ref>
*Many years before [[36,453 BBY]]
**The [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]], a Force-sensitive reptilian species from the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], arrives on [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], the homeworld of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species, via their [[Infinity Gate]] technology that allows them to travel instantaneously across the galaxy. As they had done on many worlds before, the Kwa become the Rakata's benefactors, teaching them about the Force and giving them advanced technology.<ref name="DOTJ 9">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 4]]</ref>
**The Kwa are horrified to realize that Rakata are a cannibalistic race that ignores the Kwa teachings of balance, drawing only on the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Pairing their aggression and desire for conquest with the Kwa technology, the Rakata expand out from Lehon and begin to conquer other worlds in the Unknown Regions. They establish the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] based on conquest and enslavement of Force-rich worlds, using [[Force-drive|Force-based hyperdrives]] to travel to worlds with strong Force signatures.<ref name="DOTJ 9"/>
**The Rakata desire the Infinity Gate for their empire, but when the Kwa refuse, the Rakata [[Battle between the Kwa and the Rakata|make war]] upon their benefactors. The Kwa fight back against the Rakata on Lehon, holding them off until several of their number can destroy the Infinity Gate on the planet, though many Kwa die in the process. Following the battle, the Kwa destroy or disable most of the remaining gates across the galaxy and retreat to their homeworld of Dathomir.<ref name="DOTJ 9"/>
*[[36,453 BBY]]
**The [[Tho Yor]]&mdash;eight great pyramid [[Starship/Legends|starships]] scattered across the galaxy&mdash;activate, calling [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to them. The pilgrims board the Tho Yor, which proceed to visit numerous worlds and acquire Force-sensitives of many species before traveling to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the Deep Core.<ref name="DOTJ 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>[[File:Tho_Yor_Arrival.png|thumb|right|250px|The Tho Yor arrive to Tython.]]
**The arrival of the Tho Yor at the ninth and largest Tho Yor is heralded by an enormous [[Force Storm (Tython)|Force Storm]], and the Tho Yor scatter their passengers across Tython. The [[Tythan]]s soon form the [[Je'daii Order]], a group of Force-users who strive for balance between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides of the Force]] which they know as [[Ashla (moon)/Legends|Ashla]] and [[Bogan]].<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
*[[36,019 BBY]]
**By this point, the Je'daii Order on Tython has established [[Padawan Kesh]], one of their [[Je'daii Temples]], and [[Nordia Gral]] is serving as Padawan Kesh's first [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]].<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
*c. [[35,453 BBY]]
**[[Osamael Or]] writes ''[[The Gree, and Everything I Have Found of Them in the Old City]]'' as he explores the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]] in the unexplored regions of Tython, and he disappears not long afterwards.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*More than a millennium after [[36,453 BBY]]<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
**Because of the violence of Tython's unpredictable weather and wildlife, non-Forceful individuals found it extremely difficult to survive on the world. While the original settlers all could learn to wield the Force, their children were not all gifted with the ability to touch it. The city of [[Aurum]] is tragically destroyed, and makes clear that the Je'daii can not protect their families on the volatile world.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
**Despite protests, the non-Force-sensitives are sent away from Tython for their own safety, in what will be known as the [[Second migration]]. In the process, families are torn apart, children separated from their parents and deep wounds cut into the psyche of the non-Forceful Tythans. The migration sees these individuals carried aboard ships to the moons of Bogan and Ashla. Settling there in vast stone cities, the colonists eventually move beyond the moons and colonize the other planets in the system, collectively known as the [[Settled Worlds]].<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
*c. [[35,000 BBY]][[File:ConstructionOfTheStarForge.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The Rakata build the Star Forge for their Infinite Empire.]]
**The Rakata build an enormous space station known as the [[Star Forge]] over the star [[Abo]] in the [[Lehon system]], a factory powered by the dark side that produces warships and technology for the Infinite Empire. They use it to expand their empire throughout the Unknown Regions and into the eastern galaxy.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[33,598 BBY]]
**The central control system of the Infinite Empire's [[Builder Forge|terraforming computer]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] receives its last communication from its builders.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
*[[33,357 BBY]]
**The terraforming computer on Kashyyyk malfunctions, causing a hyper-acceleration in the growth of the planet's forests and giving rise to the enormous [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
*c. [[30,500 BBY]]
**A meteor crashes on the planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], forming a crater. Millennia later, the crater will fill with water from the local aquifers and form a [[Aldera lake|lake]], over which the city of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] will be built.<ref name="AlderaMeteor">According to [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 18|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 18]], the crater on which [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] was built formed roughly three thousands years before the arrival of the Human colonists on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places around [[27,500 BBY]].</ref>
*Prior to [[30,000 BBY]]
**The [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Empire]] and the [[Kwa holdings]] engage in a territorial [[Gree-Kwa conflict|conflict]] that will last for centuries.<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. 30,000 BBY
**The [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] attempt to [[Incursion of Korriban|invade]] the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], but are repelled by the native [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] species.<ref name="Atlas" />[[File:RakataVsKillilks.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The Rakata storm a Killik nest during their war against the other Celestial client species.]]
**The Infinite Empire of the Rakata reaches its peak, linking over five hundred Force-rich worlds all across the galaxy. They wage a [[War against Celestial client species|war]] against their rivals among the Celestial client species, the Killiks, the Gree and the Kwa.<ref name="Atlas" />
***During the [[Annexation of Kwa holdings|annexation]] of the Kwa holdings, the Rakata brutally subjugate Dathomir, the homeworld of the Kwa, in revenge for the Kwa's destruction of their Infinity Gates across the galaxy.<ref name="Atlas" />
***The Rakata [[Defeat of the Gree Empire|defeat]] the Gree Empire, and drive the Gree all the way back to their home cluster. They also [[Storming of a Killik nest|storm]] a Killik nest during their expansion.<ref name="TEGtW" />
***With the Gree and the Kwa pushed back within their borders by the Infinite Empire, the war between both species ends.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Killiks vanish from Alderaan,<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]],<ref name="Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> and the galaxy at large, having been [[Great Migration|relocated]] to the Unknown Regions; modern scholars believe that the Celestials are responsible.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[28,930 BBY]]
**Master [[Shall Mar]] of the Je'daii Order writes the book ''[[A Life in Balance]]''.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*c. [[28,793 BBY]]
**A series of exploratory missions are undertaken on the planet [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] in the Tython system to locate signs of previous habitation. The missions are ultimately unsuccessful.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*Prior to [[28,000 BBY]]<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**A member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] species named [[Adas]] is born on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Due to the charcoal-colored pigmentation of his skin, unusual for the red-skinned Sith, Adas is considered a chosen being and is raised as such during his youth.<ref name="EvilNeverDies">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>
*c. 28,000 BBY<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />[[File:SithKingAdas-BoSSFtDS.png|thumb|right|200px|King Adas of the Sith.]]
**Adas wages a series of brutal conflicts against the rival Sith nations and [[Circle (Sith Pureblood)|tribes]] of his world, eventually uniting and consolidating the disparate peoples under his rule.<ref name="EvilNeverDies"/>
**Adas becomes the undisputed ruler and King of the Sith. His people will come to believe that he will live forever and that his reign will be eternal, eventually revering him as a god. The period of his rule will become known as the "[[Reign of the Ax]]".<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
*c. [[27,700 BBY]]
**Rakatan soldiers of the Infinite Empire [[Invasion of Korriban|move against Korriban]] and attempt to conquer the Sith. Adas leads his people in a defense of the planet, driving back the invaders, and captures Rakatan starships to turn them against the invaders.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Using the Rakatan [[Force-drive]]n hyperdrive technology, Adas's forces push on from Korriban, and reach [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], [[Malachor V]], and [[Tund/Legends|Tund]]. However, Adas perishes while trying to drive off the Rakata.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**Without the stabilizing influence of Adas as king, Korriban falls into a bloody [[Korriban civil war|civil war]]. As a result of the internal strife, the Sith capital is relocated to Ziost, leaving behind their desolated homeworld as a holy tombworld populated by religious fanatics.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
*At some point after c. [[27,700 BBY]]
**The successors of King Adas lead an [[Sith Empire expansion|expansion]] of its territories using captured Rakatan technology. The [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors are unleashed to conquer neighboring worlds in the [[Stygian Caldera]], destroying the homes of disobedient people. The planet Tund becomes a place of exile for heretics among the Sith.<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[27,500 BBY]]
**The Human natives of Coruscant begin to launch sublight sleeper ships over the next fifteen hundred years, seeding a number of worlds with Humans. These include [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]], Alderaan, [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]], [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], and the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The Humans also launch the ''[[Kuat Explorer]]'', which colonizes Alsakan.<ref name="Corporate">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
*c. [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]]
**The [[Gossam Courivers/Legends|Gossam Courivers]], a group of [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] explorers using the [[Tumbledrive/Legends|tumble hyperdrive]], visit the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and start a trend of Gossam colonization for the world.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] species also experiments with the tumble hyperdrive around this time.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Human colonists arrive in the Tion Cluster on sleeper ships.<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[26,053 BBY]]
**The [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]] species establish an agricultural colony on the planet  [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]] in an effort to produce enough food to support their homeworld's growing population. Varonat is covered in immense plains, and the Morodins transport stores of food to the world to allow them to convert the grasslands into edible plant life. The result produces the vast [[Great Jungle]] for which Varonat will become known thousands of years later.<ref name="First Contact">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}} states that [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]] was colonized a thousand years before the Republic's founding.</ref>
*c. [[26,000 BBY/Legends|26,000 BBY]]
**By this time, the people of Kuat have launched their own colonization ships and seeded [[Axum]], [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]], and [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] with Humans.<ref name="Atlas" />
**In the aftermath of the fourth in a series of devastating planetary conflicts,<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> the early [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] discover the [[M'dweshuu]] [[Supernova/Legends|nova]] and form the religious [[Cult of M'dweshuu]].<ref name="Essential Alien" /> The Cult quickly takes control of the entire planet of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] and rules for three decades.<ref name="Geonosis" />
**The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] species colonize the [[Roche system]].<ref name="Essential Alien" />
*[[25,823 BBY]]
**In a tragedy at the mining colony of [[Ran Dan's Folly]] on the planet Sunspot, a hundred miners die in an accident.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*[[25,818 BBY]]
**[[Lanoree Brock]] is born on Tython.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
**Je'daii Master [[Dam-Powl]] begins teaching at [[Anil Kesh]].<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*[[25,816 BBY]]
**[[Dalien Brock]] is born on Tython.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*[[25,811 BBY]]
**The miners of Ran Dan's Folly strike, leading to violent riots, and the miners eventually leave the planet.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*[[25,805 BBY]][[File:DespotWar-DotJ1.jpg|thumb|right|270px|At the Despot War, Queen Hadiya attempts to take control of the Tython system.]]
**[[Despot Queen]] [[Hadiya]] attempts to unite the crime barons of her homeworld [[Shikaakwa]] and conquer the whole [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], igniting the [[Despot War]]<ref name="DOTJ 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref>
***The charismatic Twi'lek Hadiya begins to unite the [[Nine Houses]] and the aristocracy of Shikaakwa, through charm or through force, with the help of several lieutenants, including [[Bakko]], [[Ka'un Damm]], and Hadiya's "fists," [[Shri-Lan]] and [[Gav Vannar]].<ref name="DOTJ 0"/>
***Rising to become the [[Kral (title)|Kral]], or overlord, of Shikaakwa, Hadiya seeks to unify the planet's aristocracy under a single leader, and much of the aristocracy resists her desire to conquer the entire Tython system. [[Clan Ryo]]'s [[Volnos Ryo's father|leader]] refuses Hadiya's request to join her forces, so Hadiya executes the man and his oldest son, forcing the middle son, [[Volnos Ryo]], to take up his father's title of baron and lead his house.<ref name="DOTJ 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 2]]</ref>
***The Je'daii Order on Tython, seeing that Hadiya's plans are a threat to the system's stability, decide to intervene on the side of the aristocracy.<ref name="DOTJ 0"/>
***Some of the domed cities on the planet [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] side with the Je'daii, while others side with the Despot Queen. When the Je'daii discover that three domes around the city of [[Greenwood Station]] are supplying Hadiya with weapons, they attempt to convince the domes to stop, but ultimately resort to [[Bombing of Nox|bombing]] the cities. The Je'daii warn the domes's inhabitants that the cities will be bombed, but thousands still die in the attacks.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
***Hadiya launches a full invasion of Tython with her [[Despot Army]], that she had trained and armed in secret. During the invasion of Je'daii Master [[Rajivari]] leads the Je'daii in battle and earns the nickname "General". [[Telaat]], Temple Master of [[Akar Kesh]] and leader of the [[Je'daii Council]], is slain, leading a younger Master named Ketu to succeed him.<ref name="DOTJ 6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref>
***Seeking revenge against Hadiya for the death of his father and brother, Volnos Ryo seeks out [[Daegen Lok]], a Je'daii Ranger and the best friend of Volnos's younger brother [[Hawk Ryo|Hawk]], and with his help, approaches the Despot Army claiming to be a disgraced Ranger seeking to join them. Lok rises through the ranks to become a valued lieutenant of Hadiya, and the two become lovers as Lok begins to lose sight of his mission.<ref name="DOTJ 10">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 5]]</ref>[[File:Hadiya_and_Daegen.png|thumb|right|270px|Daegen Lok fights alongside Hadiya at the Battle of Tython.]]
***Hadiya [[Battle of Tython|sieges]] the Temple of [[Kaleth]], producing massive casualties on both sides. During the battle, Volnos Ryo confronts Lok and reminds him of his mission to end the war, so Lok kills Hadiya in their tent by stabbing her, fighting his way out of the camp, and leaving one soldier alive to tell the story. Hadiya's death breaks the invasion, as her generals turn on each other, and the Je'daii defeat the remnants of the Despot Army.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
*[[25,802 BBY]]
**Lanoree Brock and Dalien Brock set out on their [[Great Journey]] across the planet Tython, that ends with Dalien fleeing into the depths of the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]] and being presumed dead.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*[[25,801 BBY]]
**Je'daii Ranger [[Vulk]] dies in a [[Cloud Chaser]] crash on [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]].<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*[[25,800 BBY]]
**Daegen Lok deviates from the conventional wisdom and descends into the [[Chasm]] below [[Anil Kesh]] temple, where he and Hawk Ryo are overcome by a terrible Force vision, in wich an army of dark warriors wielding [[Forcesaber|blades of frozen fire]] march across [[Ska Gora]], led by a [[Tau (individual)|being with one red eye]]. To combat this, they see themselves leading the Je'daii armies against the threat. Driven mad by the visions, Lok falls to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and is taken before the Je'daii Council for questioning. The Council does not believe in Lok's warning and banishes him to the moon of [[Bogan]] until he renounces his vision and returns to Balance in the Force. Over the next seven years, Lok lives out his exile in solitude, carving an enormous mural of himself wielding the blade of fire, and numerous pictures of the weapon.<ref name="DOTJ 6"/>
*Between [[25,797 BBY]] and [[25,793 BBY]]
**The Wookiee warlord [[Gharcanna]] leads many of his species to [[Wookiee land wars|settle]] in the forests on the planet [[Ska Gora]], ignoring it is illegal, and the Je'daii Council dispatches Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock to settle the matter. Brock tries diplomatic methods to convince Gharcanna to leave, but when they fail, the Ranger is forced to turn her laser cannons on the Wookiees, in order to prevent civil war breaking out between the Wookiees and the floating city-ships above Ska Gora's surface. In her [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|''Peacemaker''-class cruiser]], she bombards the surface where the Wookiees lived, killing all of the illegal settlers. Brock will be haunted by her actions on Ska Gora.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
*25,793 BBY[[File:Into_the_Void_second_sketch_revised.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock.]]
**A group of Twi'lek [[Rescue on Zerist|kidnap]] [[Oma Dessain]], the daughter of mining magnate [[Eomin Dessain]], on [[Zerist]], a moon of the gas giant [[Obri]]. Je'daii Ranger Hawk Ryo discovers that a Shikaakwan ship registered to his brother, the crime lord Baron Volnos Ryo, was present on Zerist during Oma's kidnapping, leading him to investigate the evacuated workers' town of [[Kainnan]]. Ryo fights Twi'lek guards on a five-story building and discovers Oma bound and gagged in a workers' dormitory. The [[Sokar volcano]] located nearby erupts, providing a distraction. Ryo frees Oma and uses the Force to leap between the rooftops and escape the town.<ref name="Eruption">{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}}</ref>
**Dalien Brock becomes obsessed with escaping from the Tython system, and gets involved with a group known as the [[Stargazers]], led secretly by some of the system's most elite business leaders and philanthropists. They hope to use [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] schematics to activate a legendary [[hypergate]] rumored to exist in the Old City. Using the diary of [[Osamael Or]] for direction, Dalien and his cabal set in motion a [[Stargazer Uprising|plan]] to create a device that will charge the hypergate so that they can leave Tython.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
***A member of the Stargazer leadership, [[Kara (Je'daii)|Kara]], leaks information to the Je'daii about Dalien's plans. The Je'daii Council, fearing this will lead to the formation of a black hole and the destruction of the system, dispatches Lanoree Brock to end the threat.<ref name="Into the Void"/>
***[[Attack on Kalimahr]].<ref name="Into the Void"/>
***[[Confrontation in the Old City]].<ref name="Into the Void"/>
***[[Massacre at Pan Deep]].<ref name="Into the Void"/>
***[[Skirmish at Pan Deep]].<ref name="Into the Void"/>
***[[Tragedy of Greenwood Station]].<ref name="Into the Void"/>
**The [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], working in the service of his master, [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] of the Infinite Empire, discovers [[Tatooine]], and Tul'kar launches a [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquest]] of the planet. The native [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]] are enslaved, one of their [[Unidentified Tatooine city|cities]] is burned, and many of their Force-sensitives are purged.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
**Baron [[Garto]], head of one the Nine Houses that rule the planet Shikaakwa, and a rival of Baron Volnos Ryo, [[Assassination attempt on Baron Volnos Ryo|hires]] the Devaronian assassin [[Jaris Kan]] to kill Ryo, but he is saved by his daughter, Je'daii Journeyer [[Tasha Ryo]].<ref name="DOTJ 2"/>
**Xesh is ordered by Tul'kar with finding a Force-strong planet in the Deep Core. He is successful in finding a path to Tython, but Tul'kar's starship [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|''Devourer'']] explodes over the planet, leaving Xesh the only survivor, and he is confronted by Je'daii Journeyers [[Shae Koda]], Tasha Ryo, and [[Sek'nos Rath]]. Defeated by the Je'daii, Xesh is exiled to the moon of Bogan to meditate on the Force.<ref name="DOTJ 2"/>
**On Bogan, the exiled Je'daii [[Daegen Lok]], recruits Xesh in his mission to construct new [[Forcesaber|Forcesabers]], the powerful weapons of the Force Hounds. The two escape Bogan and travel the [[Settled Worlds]] of the Tython system, acquiring the materials needed for the Forcesabers.<ref name="DOTJ 5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]]</ref>
**[[Hunt for Xesh and Daegen Lok]].<ref name="DOTJ 2"/>
**Predor [[Skal'nas]] of the Infinite Empire, seeking to reverse his species's gradual loss of control over the Force by acquiring an [[Infinity Gate]] said to exist on Tython, launches a [[Invasion of the Tython system|campaign of conquest]] against the Je'daii Order and the Settled Worlds.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
***The Rakata's first strike is an [[Attack on Fury Station|attack]] on [[Fury Squadron]], an outpost in orbit over [[Furies Gate]], the farthest planet in the system. The space station is devastated during the assault.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
*[[25,792 BBY]]
**Invasion of the Tython system[[File:Shikaakwa_battle.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The Je'daii defend the Tython system from the Infinite Empire's invasion.]]
***The Infinite Empire [[Capture of Obri|captures]] the gas giant [[Obri]] and its moons.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
***The Rakata [[Capture of Mawr|capture]] the gas giant [[Mawr]] and its numerous moons.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
***Skal'nas' forces [[First battle of Tython|attack]] the planet Tython, but the Je'daii Order repells the Rakatan assault.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
***Forced back, the Infinite Empire moves to [[Fall of Ska Gora|capture]] the forest world of [[Ska Gora]], and many members of the Je'daii Order die in battle. In the aftermath of the fall of Ska Gora, the other Settled Worlds join forces with the Je'daii in defense of the Tython system.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
***The Je'daii Order foresees that the Rakata will strike at the planet [[Shikaakwa]], and counter [[Sub-Predor]] [[Ceh'let]]'s [[Battle of Shikaakwa|attack]] with one of their own. Numerous Je'daii, led by General Daegen Lok, ambush the [[Flesh Raider]]s sent to attack [[Ryo Fortress]], the command center from which General [[Rajivari]] is commanding the joint forces of the Je'daii and the Settled Worlds. Losing over half of her forces, Ceh'let is forced to withdraw back to the Rakatan stronghold on Ska Gora.<ref name="DOTJ 11">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]]</ref>
***Xesh comes up with a plan to assassinate of Predor Skal'nas and cause his generals to fight each other for dominance. Using his Force Hound training, he locates Skal'nas' base of operations and launches an [[Attack on Ska Gora|attack]] on Ska Gora. However, it is a trap and Rakatan forces ambush the Je'daii task force and take many of them prisoner, before encasing them in tubes in a chamber under the Rakatan fortress.<ref name="DOTJ 12">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 2]]</ref>
***The Rakatan forces under Predor Skal'nas [[Second battle of Tython|invade]] the planet Tython, while also decimating the forces of the Settled Worlds on Tython's moon Ashla, and Skal'nas himself descends into the Chasm with Xesh. However, [[Sek'nos Rath]] manages to break free of his imprisonment by the Rakata, and leads a force of freed slaves to the battle. Daegen Lok and [[Shae Koda]] follow Skal'nas and Xesh into the Chasm while Sek'nos fights and defeats [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]]. At the bottom of the chasm, Lok engages Skal'nas while Shae squares off with Xesh. Daegen attempts a [[Mind trick/Legends#Mind twist|Mind twist]] by getting inside Skal'nas's mind, but it backfires when he feels the terror and agony of the Predor's victims, while Shae attempts to appeal to Xesh's humanity. All of a sudden, Skal'nas activates the Infinity Gate.<ref name="DOTJ 15">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 5]]</ref>[[File:Second_Tython.png|thumb|right|250px|The Force Hound Trill leads the Infinite Empire forces at the invasion of Tython.]]
***At the temple of [[Anil Kesh]], [[Tasha Ryo]] takes the [[Holocron of A'nang]] to the lowest level at his request, where he tells them that the coming of the Rakata activated a fail-safe mechanism in the Holocron, saying it is time to activate the [[Tho Yor]]. Skal'nas blasts her with a charge of Force lightning, but Xesh attacks him. Tasha jumps into the pit, a charge of Force energy surges up and awakens the Tho Yor, and they open fire on the Rakata ships, while a surge of energy flows down into the Chasm, and destroys the gate. Xesh then defeats Skal'nas, whose body falls into the remnants of the gate where it is incinerated. Afterwards, the Rakatan forces feel Skal'nas's demise through the Force and flee, with the Sub Predors turning on each other in panic, and the remaining Rakata ships wiped out by the Settled Worlds fleet.<ref name="DOTJ 15"/>
*Between c. 25,792 BBY and c. [[25,783 BBY]]
**The Je'daii split into two groups, one which uses the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Ashla]], which will later be called the light side of the Force to achieve knowledge, and another which uses the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]], which will later be called the dark side of the Force to gain power. With the schism, a [[Force Wars|series of conflicts]] arises between the two factions. The followers of Ashla form a new organization called the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Among those first Jedi are [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Rajivari]], [[Garon Jard]], [[Cala Brin]] and [[Ters Sendon]], who help formulate the tenets of the Order. Rajivari and Jard organize week-longs gatherings, the earliest form of [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], with many of their peers, to reflect on how to protect the Order from the dark side and to increase the Order's wisdom.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
**Master Rajivari, disagreeing with the policies that his fellow founders had agreed upon for the Order, turns to the Dark side and launches a [[Rajivari's purges|purge]] to destroy the Light side-based Jedi Order and rebuilt it from the ground with his own [[Principles of Rajivari|principles]] and [[Rajivari's followers|followers]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
**Rajivari is killed in his attempt to murder his fellow Masters, and his followers barricade in Rajivari's fortress of [[Kaleth]], where they put up a [[Siege of Kaleth|last stand]] against the Order. All of Rajivari's followers are killed.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*25,783 BBY[[File:ForceWars-TJP.jpg|thumb|right|230px|The followers of Ashla and the followers of Bogan fight on Tython.]]
**The wars between the light and the dark side end with a [[Force Cataclysm|cataclysm]] that destroys the planet's biosphere and renders the world uninhabitable. The Jedi Order decide to abandon Tython, taking with them all surviving text and scriptures they can find. The Order flees the Deep Core in favor of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], a wide swath of the galaxy which has yet to be explored. Discovering a verdant planet much like Tython had once been, the Jedi colonize the world and name it [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*c. [[25,200 BBY]]
**After generations of galactic supremacy and control, the Infinite Empire begins to fracture. Huge slave revolts erupt throughout the borders of the Empire along with various factions vying for control. This leads to a [[Rakatan Civil War|civil war]] throughout Rakatan controlled space. Already weakened by warfare, the Rakata are suddenly struck by a deadly [[Rakatan plague|plague]] (possibly created by one of the slave species) that spreads rapidly through their ranks and nearly exterminates their species.<ref name="Atlas" />
**A mutation in the disease causes the Rakata to lose their connection with the Force, and they loose the ability to manipulate their own technology. With their slave masters weakened, the populace of many enslaved worlds rebel. The Infinite Empire begins to collapse as member worlds expel their Rakatan masters. The all-but-destroyed Rakata abandon their conquests and retreat to the safety of their homeworld of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**On the planet [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], [[Ardustagg]] the Absolute, leader of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], leads a series of mass uprisings against the Rakata, freeing Varl from their rule. In the aftermath, the Hutts seize control of the Rakatan technology left behind and use it to forge their own [[Hutt Empire|empire]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />[[File:Kingdom_of_Barseg.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The Tionese Kingdoms by 25,200 BBY.]]
**The [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] nobleman [[Xer VIII]] is born on the planet [[Argai]]. He will become a prominent pirate chieftain in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
*Between c. [[25,150 BBY]] and c. [[25,130 BBY]]<ref name="Xim Week"/>
**Xer has his fleets explore the [[Indrexu Spiral|Ihala Spiral]], where they manage to carve out new secret routes and hiding places. He then has his fleets hide within the Spiral, from which they harass shipping within the more backwater regions of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], and eventually raid distant worlds such as [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]] and [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]]. The wealth and success of these raids draws more raiders to Xer and his fleet.<ref name="Xim Week" />
**Hailed as the Lord of Argai, Xer launches a [[Xer's Campaigns|series of military campaigns]] to claim more territory for himself, declaring the [[Kingdom of Argai]] within the Kingdom of Cron.<ref name="Xim Week" />
***He begins [[Campaign on the Ihala Route|cutting a swath]] through the [[Indrexu Route|Ihala Route]], overcoming the satrapies of younger Cronese nobles and weak descendants of long-dead warlords.<ref name="Xim Week" />
****Xer [[Battle of Dravione|captures]] the planet [[Dravione]] for his Kingdom.<ref name="Xim Week" />
****The Argaians capture the planet [[Corlass]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
****The Kingdom of Argai [[Battle of Panna|conquers]] the planet [[Panna]] via Corlass.<ref name="Xim Week" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
***King [[Ferece]] of Cron, in response to Xer's rapid expansions, summons him to his capital of [[Chandaar]]. There, Xer is offered a series of noble titles in exchange for an oath of fealty to Ferece and the Kingdom of Cron. Xer, unimpressed by the court of Ferece and Chandaar, musters a considerable fleet at Panna and launches a [[Campaign against the Kingdom of Cron|campaign]] toward Chandaar.<ref name="Xim Week" />
****The Lord of Argai [[Battle of Duinarbulon|engages]] a Cronese battlefleet at the planet [[Duinarbulon]] and smashes the opposition, allowing him to push on.<ref name="Xim Week" /><ref name="TEGtW" />
****[[Pasmin]], [[Soruus]], and [[Barancar]] fall to Xer's forces, leaving him free to move against Chandaar.<ref name="Xim Week" />
****Xer [[Battle of Chandaar|storms]] the Cronese capital, causing Ferece and his courtiers to flee in terror. He is named the new King of Cron, and makes a vow to his new, cowering court that he will make the stars tremble at his name.<ref name="Xim Week" /><ref name="TEGtW" />[[File:Cronese_Sweeps.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The armies of Xer advance through the Kingdom of Cron.]]
***Xer [[Cronese Sweeps|subjugates]] a series of pocket kingdoms to take complete control of the Kingdom of Cron.<ref name="Xim Week" /><ref name="TEGtW" />
****He sends warlords and nobles he considers worthy into battle against rebellious Cronese worlds and independent planets on the kingdom's borders, taking their heirs hostage as guarantees of loyalty.<ref name="Xim Week" />
****During this time, Xer's reputation is eclipsed by that of his teenage son, [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], who emerges as a warlord during the campaign. He [[Battle of Pasmin|kills]] everyone in the [[Timber Palace of Pasmin|Timber Palace]] of [[Pasmin]], [[Battle of Eibon|sets]] the royal barges of [[Eibon]] adrift into the heart of the Ihala Spiral, and [[Battle of Nuswatta|razes]] the [[High Fane of Xo]] on [[Nuswatta]], converting the theocracy to Xer's service.<ref name="Xim Week" />
***Xer, commanding a united and powerful Kingdom of Cron with a battle-tested starfleet, seeks to expand his territory in the entire [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], and [[Campaign against the Three Allied Kingdoms|targets]] the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]], an alliance of the kingdoms of [[Kingdom of Jaminere|Jaminere]], [[Kingdom of Cadinth|Cadinth]] and [[Kingdom of Barseg|Barseg]] on his north-rimward flank. Moving along the [[Cadinth Run]], he [[Battle of Jaminere|conquers]] [[Battle of Cadinth (Xer's Campaigns)|the]] [[Battle of Barseg|three]] kingdoms, as well as worlds such as [[Arcan IV]], [[Corlax 4|Corlax]], and [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]<ref name="Xim Week" />
***Xer then conquers beyond the Ihala Spiral. Departing from [[Algor]], he [[Campaign in the Back Spiral|moves]] north up the [[Back Spiral]], winning victories at [[Battle of Caluula (Xer's Campaigns)|Caluula]], [[Battle of Brigia (Xer's Campaigns)|Brigia]] and [[Battle of Tion|Tion]]. After the conquest, Xer builds gleaming palaces on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and deeds the world to his concubines and their retainers. The world ultimately becomes known as "the Circlet of the Tion".<ref name="Xim Week" />
***Xer [[Campaign against the Livien League|moves against]] the only power standing against the Kingdom of Cron in the Tion Cluster, the [[Livien League]], a confederation of worlds built around [[Livien]], [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] and [[Kanaver]]. His armies depart rom Corlax and Barseg, but are [[Battle of Amarin|defeated]] at [[Amarin]], and [[Battle of Lorrad|again]] at [[Lorrad]].<ref name="Xim Week" />[[File:Xers_Empire.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The Kingdom of Cron by the end of Xer's conquests.]]
*25,130 BBY
**Xer understands that he has overextended himself, he retreats from the Livien League's borders and looks to solidify his existing holdings, completing the transformation of the Kingdom of Cron into a true [[Xim's empire|empire]]. He establishes a bureaucracy effective at commerce and warfare, and reorganizes his empire into three provinces, with the capitals being Chandaar, Cadinth, and Raxus Prime.<ref name="Xim Week" />
**Xer VIII relinquishes the throne to Prince Xim and retires to [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**Xim resolves to complete his father's conquest of the Livien League. He [[Battle of Jhantoria|defeats]] the League at [[Jhantoria]], and prepares the raze the League's capital of Desevro as an example to those who would oppose him, but is persuaded not to by the planet's military ruler, [[Maslovar Tiatiov]]. Tiatiov takes Xim on a tour of his world's first-class academies and shows him the efficiency of the planet's bureaucracy. Xim, impressed, spares the planet and proclaimes it the Fourth Throne, adopting much of Desevro's methods in training his army and government.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[25,126 BBY]]
**Armed with Desevro's knowledge, Xim developes armies and fleets which use the highest technology available at the time, including [[Beam tube/Legends|beam tubes]], [[Kiirium/Legends|kiirium]], [[Mytag crystal/Legends|mytag crystals]], and [[War-robot|war-robots]]. He uses them to go beyond the Tion Cluster, begining his [[Xim's Expansionist Period|Expansionist Period]]. He controls his conquests through his much-feared secret police, the [[GenoHaradan]], and the use of terror tactics such as mass executions. Xim also dispatches Tionese colonists by the thousands to uninhabited or depopulated worlds in an effort to strengthen his growing empire.<ref name="Atlas" />[[File:Thanium_Kiirium.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Xim expands his father's Empire far beyond the limits of the Tion Cluster.]]
*From 25,126 BBY to [[25,116 BBY]]
**Xim conquers the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]]. Departing from Barseg to Thanium, one force moves to conquer [[Stenos/Legends|Maldont]], and from there splits to take [[Korriban/Legends|Pesegam]] and [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], while another force takes [[Arda system/Legends|Ethain]] and [[Lucazec/Legends|Far Thanium]]. Another force leaves from Thanium to take [[Felucia/Legends|Galuch]], [[Mossak]], [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]], [[Draukyze]] and [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]. Finally, a third force from [[Arcan system/Legends|Arcan]] conquers [[Columex/Legends|Nardolin]], [[Belderone/Legends|Vartholium]], [[Trogan/Legends|Ethullum]] and [[Jomark/Legends|Bynas]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] and [[Stenax]] species are enslaved, while others are exterminated. Empty worlds are settled by Tionese colonists, their numbers steadily increasing as part of Xim's strategy of conquest. The Thanium Worlds become the largest and richest of Xim's new provinces.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Xim's forces then move from [[Kanaver]] to [[Janodral Mizar]], before splitting to conquer [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] and [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]], and turning south to [[Florn/Legends|Tinatorn]] and [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]]. The second force move from Janodral Mizar to [[Sembla/Legends|Utavurk]] and [[Yutusk]], before encountering a challenge at the [[Battle of Ranroon]]. The Queen of [[Ranroon]], [[Hylei Indrexu Cortess]], fights Xim's invading forces for every inch of ground on her planet. Despite being defeated, Indrexu makes a strong impression on Xim, who renames the Ihala Spiral nebula to the [[Indrexu Spiral]] in her honor.<ref name="Xim Week" />
*From [[25,120 BBY]] to [[25,096 BBY]].
**Rich in the valuable military resource [[Kiirium/Legends|kiirium]], the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]] are a vital addition to Xim's military-industrial complex, and three forces movilize to conquer the region. One moves from Pakuuni to [[OHS1782-03 system/Legends|Xoraes]] via [[OHS2132-04 system/Legends|Ulonsus]]. The second from [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]] to [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]], then to [[OHS4140-02 system/Legends|Balshebr]] and [[OHS3842-03|Astigone]]. From there via [[Altratonne|Kveror]] to [[Handooine/Legends|Gwynhes]], where it links up with the third force sent from [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] to take [[Wyndigal 2|Huronom]] and [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Far Barseg]]. Both forces then conquer [[Jabiim/Legends|Gwynhes Minor]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[25,102 BBY]][[File:WarbotsVsSlugsASciFiChannelOriginalMovie-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Xim movilizes his fleets against the Hutt Empire.]]
**By [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] and [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] traders, Xim learns of the existence of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The [[Hutt Empire]] is said to be staggeringly wealthy and as large as Xim's dominion. A diplomatic mission is send to the outlying Hutt colony of [[Boonta/Legends|Ko Vari]], where some-dozen Hutt nobles are in attendance, and they offer Xim and the Tionese the chance to live under Hutt rule as particularly favoured slaves. Enraged, Xim resolves to [[Xim Wars|conquer]] the Hutts, taking the old [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] title ''[[Daritha]]'', Ruler of Worlds, as his own in a lavish ceremony on his capital of Chandaar.<ref name="Xim Week" />
**Xim's war fleet moves to flank Hutt territories, pushing to the [[Junkfort system|Kossimur system]] to flank Ko Vari and as far south as [[Formos/Legends|Xoloch]] and [[Moralan]] to flank Sleheyron. Then Xim launches a two-pronged attack on Ko Vari and Sleheyron. Ko Vari is [[Sack of Ko Vari|sacked]] and devastated in an orbital bombardment. However, the commander of the Hutt defense, [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu]], costs the Tionese dearly by sacrificing countless slaves in suicide attacks on the Despot's ships and ground forces. The [[Battle of Sleheyron|invasion of Sleheyron]] fails, and Xim's ships are driven back to [[Kessel/Legends|Xo's Eye]], where many are lost in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] black hole cluster.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Impressed by Boonta's military skill, the Hutt leader, [[Clan-General]] [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]] gives him command of privateers to harass Xim's shipping. The raids lead Xim to handle logistics in an increasingly paranoid fashion, sending secret shipments to fortified bases.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[25,100 BBY]]
**Kossak lures Xim into a ritual combat at [[Vontor]], a site long-used for such purposes by the Hutts. Xim's fleet is demolished by the Hutts at the [[First Battle of Vontor]], the Hutt strategy coordinated by Boonta. Despite this, Xim disregards the Hutts' demands to withdraw from occupied worlds claimed by them.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Xim rebuils his forces and sends newly built warships into the Si'klaata Cluster to raid [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] and [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]. Additionally, the Tionese sponsor an uprising among the Hutt slaves on [[Moralan]], who overthrow their oppressors. The [[Parliament of Moralan]] proclaims an independent [[Moralan republic]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**Kossak challenges Xim to another ritual combat. Xim chooses to fight on the ground in the [[Second Battle of Vontor]], and his elite [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers]] and other ground forces are defeated by [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruan]] [[Flechette/Legends|flechetteers]] and [[Cyborrean]] heavy infantry.<ref name="TEGtW" />[[File:Hutt_Xim_war.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Hutts send their armies against the forces of Xim.]]
**Representatives of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the three races of the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]]: the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] under [[Barada M'Beg]], the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] under [[D'we'mouk]], and the [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodrans]] under [[Kl'ieutu Mutela]], sign the [[Treaty of Vontor]],  putting the three native races in a state of permanent servitude towards the Hutts.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Xim's [[High Command (Xim's empire)|High Command]] begins to turn against the war, warning of the Hutt pirates loose in the Kiirium Reaches, and suggesting Ximt to suspend the campaign and fortify his empire. Xim regards this as treason and sends many officers to their execution at the [[Forbidden Gardens of Nuswatta/Legends|Forbidden Gardens of Nuswatta]]. He buys time by conceding the [[Moralan system/Legends|Moralan system]] to the Hutts, and Boonta's forces [[Invasion of Moralan|sterilize]] the planet as a lesson to the Hutts' slave species.<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="TEGtW" />
**Boonta leads the recapture of Ko Vari and Kossak challenges Xim to a third ritual combat. Xim is at the [[Third Battle of Vontor]] thanks to the manpower of the newly enslaved races, in addition to the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] species. Xim is captured and blinded, paraded throughout Hutt Space, and will eventually die a slave in the dungeons of Kossak on [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], though Tionese history will claim that he was treacherously killed at Vontor.<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="TEGtW" />
**[[Borte Belgoth]] is commissioned to construct a set of hyperspace beacons, one of which becomes known as [[Belgoth's Beacon]]. Belgoth's Beacon bears the faces of a [[Columi/Legends|Columi]], a [[cacodemon]], and a [[Molator/Legends|molator]], and sits along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />

==[[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] '''(25,053 BBY-20,000 BBY)'''==
*[[25,053 BBY]]
**With the Rakatan [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] having been reverse-engineered by Corellian scientists, the inhabitants of the Core Worlds begin to expand outward and settle the known galaxy.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
**The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] is founded with the signing of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]], and Coruscant becomes the new government's capital.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*[[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]
**The [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] is founded, linking Coruscant with Ossus and the Tion Cluster.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] is mapped, ensuring the economic dominance of Corellia in the forming Republic; the Corellian Run forms the southern border of the Slice.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Republic scouts make contact with the Jedi Order on Ossus, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Haune Tiar]] accompanies the scouts back to the Republic. After conferring for several weeks, the Order pledge themselves to the Republic's service.<ref name="History 12">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 12: The Birth of the Republic}}</ref>
**With the development of the hyperdrive, Queen [[Rana Mas Trehalt|Rana]] allows for a wave of colonization to embark from Duros; one of the colony worlds is the planet [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]],<ref name="Atlas" /> which is colonized by a group of Duros led by [[Chla C'cHaan]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Sanbra Duros">{{GamerCite|2|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros}}</ref>
**The Jedi [[Sar Agorn]] takes on a Padawan in [[Cope Shykrill]], but Shykrill falls to the dark side of the Force and is struck down. {{Circa}}<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
*Prior to [[24,500 BBY]]
**The [[Kashi Mer Dynasty|Kashi Mer]] Jedi Knight [[Xendor]], who was exiled from his homeworld for embracing the darker aspects of the Force, and who wishes to study the Bogan more, grows vocal in his criticism of what he perceives as the Jedi Order's increasingly exclusionary ways about using the Force, and petitions the leaders of the Jedi Order to be allowed to depart Ossus in order to create a new academy. There, he hopes to teach and study alternative traditions of the Force, such as [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu]], the [[Followers of Palawa|Palawa]], the [[Way of the Dark]] and the [[Protectorate of the Hidden]]. The leaders of the Jedi Order refuse Xendor's request, but he exits in defiance despite their decision. He finds a supporter in a young [[Steel Hand of Palawa]] named [[Arden Lyn]], who shares his views and is dissatisfied with the Jedi Order embracing the philosophy of the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] people.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>[[File:Arden_Lyn_and_Xendor.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Xendor and Arden Lyn lead the Legions of Lettow.]]
**Xendor and Lyn depard Ossus to establish a [[Legionnaire Academy|new academy]] on [[Lettow]]. Increasingly larger groups of Jedi leave Ossus to join Xendor's new group and study mysteries of the Force that had been forbidden to them under the Jedi Order. Eventually, Xendor's followers come to be known as the [[Legions of Lettow]].
*[[24,500 BBY]]
**A conflict arises between the Jedi and the Legions of Lettow, which will later be known as the [[First Great Schism]].<ref name="Warfare"/>
***The Schism sees Xendor's death in the [[Battle of Columus]], and the conflict ends not long afterwards as the Order invaded Lettow.<ref name="Warfare" />
***Following the death of Xendor, Arden Lyn, now the Legions' leader, was tracked down by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]] to [[Irkalla]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> they [[Duel on Irkalla|dueled]] until Pina disarmed Lyn of her sword. Unwilling to concede defeat, she channeled her strongest emotions&ndash;rage and sorrow, love for [[Xendor]], and despair over what she believed had been unfairly taken from them&ndash;through the [[Kashi Mer Dynasty|Kashi Mer]] [[Kashi Mer talisman|talisman]], to shatter Pina's katana blade, and drive its pieces into his body, fatally wounding him. However, Pina was able to use the technique of [[Morichro/Legends|''morichro'']] to stop Lyn's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] before he died.<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[24,000 BBY]]
**The [[Tionese War]] begins: the Tionese unite as the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] and attack the Republic, storming down the Perlemian. The Republic begins producing warships at Core shipyards, but the Tionese push into the heart of the Republic and bomb numerous worlds. The Republic ultimately repels the Tionese with a desperate counterattack by numerous Core systems, sparking a series of offensives and counteroffensives that last around a century.<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[23,900 BBY]]
**The Tionese War comes to an end as the Republic devastates the worlds of the Tion Cluster, though the Republic's sterilization of Desevro prompts the Jedi to break with the Republic.<ref name="Warfare" />
**The Republic negotiates with the Jedi, who eventually agree to serve as the Republic's watchmen.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[23,643 BBY]]
**The planet [[Uphrades]] experiences a period of significant volcanic activity, resulting in especially fertile soil tens of thousands of years later.<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|Uphrades}}</ref>

*c. [[22,800 BBY]]
**A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Unidentified Jedi scout/Legends|scout]] follows the Force's call into the Unknown Regions, discovering the crystal world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. Ilum soon becomes an important religious world for the Jedi Order.<ref name="Atlas" />

*c. [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]]
**The planet [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] is settled.<ref name="Coruscant and Core">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

*[[20,100 BBY]]
**By this time, most of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] have been settled.<ref name="Atlas" />

==[[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] (20,000 BBY-17,018 BBY)==
*[[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]]
**The [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] begins, sparking an era of expansion for the Galactic Republic and the widespread colonization of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] is settled by Republic dissidents fleeing corruption in the Core Worlds. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet Metellos attempts to establish a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]] that connects it with Coruscant and points westward to [[Orooturoo]].<ref name="Coruscant and Core" />
**[[Roni von Wasaki]] is born. {{Circa}}<ref name="von Wasaki Birthdate">The article "[[Disturbance in the Force (article)|Disturbance in the Force]]" states that Roni von Wasaki was active in the frontier regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] more than 20,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. This places his [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] and period of activity at sometime prior to [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], as the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was destroyed in the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], according to [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]. As established by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the period of galactic history between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and 20,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] is known as the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Period]].</ref>

*c. [[19,997 BBY]]
**The planet [[Neona]] undergoes a dramatic climate change that submerges the planet's surface, driving the [[Unidentified Neona species|native species]] to extinction.<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

*c. [[19,000 BBY]]
**The planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] undergoes abrupt climate change, which causes the planet's glacial reserves to melt; all of Kamino's landmasses will be completely submerged within two hundred years.<ref name="Atlas" />

*[[18,780 BBY]]
**The [[Shawken Spire]], a massive spire that touches low orbit and was constructed over the course of nine thousand years, is destroyed.<ref name="Atlas" />

*18,000 BBY<!-- Do not link this. -->
**The [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] has been formed by this time.<ref name="Atlas" />

==The [[Indecta Era]] (17,018 BBY-15,000 BBY)==
*[[17,018 BBY]]
**The [[Indecta Era]] begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
**The [[First Alsakan Conflict]] begins, sparking fourteen thousand years of conflict between Alsakan and Coruscant. Alsakan leads its supporters, the Axis worlds, in blocking the [[Grand Companies]] of the Spin from expanding south, and the trading conglomerates are backed by Duros merchant barons and the Coruscant-dominated Republic.<ref name="Warfare" />
**Republic forces conquer the planet [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]].<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[17,012 BBY]]
**Alsakani forces [[Alsakani liberation of Virujansi|liberate]] Virujansi.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[17,000 BBY]]
**Rogue [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] scientists transplant a number of [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] to the [[Quermia system/Legends|Quermia system]], where they terraform the planet [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]] into a paradise and genetically manipulate the Xexto, resulting in the evolution of the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] species.<ref name="Power of the Jedi">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

*[[16,921 BBY]]
**The [[Battle of Kes]], the only direct armed conflict between the Republic and Alsakan during the early Alsakan Conflicts, occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[16,820 BBY]]
**The [[First Siege of Porus Vida]] occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[16,800 BBY]]
**The [[Siege of Belasco]] occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[16,782 BBY]]
**The [[Celebratus Archive]] is founded on the planet [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]].<ref name="Atlas" />

*c. [[16,700 BBY]]
**The First Alsakan Conflict ends as the Bureau of Ships and Services forces a peace&mdash;the Bureau threatens to withhold access to the hyperspace beacons.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[16,200 BBY]]
**The [[Second Alsakan Conflict]] begins.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[16,100 BBY]]
**The [[Second Siege of Porus Vida]] occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[16,000 BBY]]
**The Second Alsakan Conflict's [[Gizer Campaign]] occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[15,600 BBY]]
**The [[Core Campaigns]], part of the Second Alsakan Conflict, take place.<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[15,500 BBY]]
**The [[Duinuogwuin Contention]]: Republic scouts encounter the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]], or Star Dragons, near [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] and incur the leviathans' wrath. The Star Dragons attack Coruscant, sparking mass panic,<ref name="Warfare" /> but [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Fillorean]] contacts the attackers and, upon discovering they are sentient, negotiates a peace with the philosopher [[Borz'Mat'oh]].<ref name="Coruscant and Core" />
**Fillorean and Borz'Mat'oh collaborate to found the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]].<ref name="Coruscant and Core" />

*[[15,480 BBY]]
**The [[Strontium Raid]] on [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]] occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />

*c. [[15,400 BBY]]
**The Second Alsakan Conflict comes to an end.<ref name="Warfare" />

==[[Kymoodon Era]] (15,000 BBY-11,987 BBY)==
*c. [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]
**The [[Kymoodon Era]] begins.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]] of [[Yablari/Legends|Yablari]] join the Republic.<ref name="Ultimate Alien">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
**The [[Hutt Cataclysms]] come to an end; by this time, the Hutt homeworld of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] and the other colony worlds are lifeless wastes, forcing the Hutts to relocate to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Evocar]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] heeds calls for the reestablishment of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="Warfare" />
**The [[Cremlevian War]], which sees the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] conquer many of the planets in their galaxy before turning on themselves, comes to an end, and their homeworld [[Yuuzhan'tar]] strips the species of their ability to use the Force.<ref name="New Essential Alien" />
**The [[Aquala/Legends|Aquala]] and [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] species fight a [[Aqualish Civil War|civil war]], but unite when an offworld exploratory vessel lands on [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. The united [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] species kill the explorers and take their ship, learning to reproduce it.<ref name="Essential Alien" />
**A few decades later, the Aqualish embark on a [[Aqualish–Republic War|campaign of conquest]], but are quickly stopped by the Republic.<ref name="Essential Alien" />
**[[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Dahrtag]], later known more commonly as Necropolis, is first settled by a religious order who are appalled by the way that Core cultures have grown more similar to each other. They set aside parts of the world for each culture, and invite any culture to inter their dead on the planet in their specific tradition.<ref name="Alien Anthology">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
*[[14,743 BBY]]
**The [[Herglic Crush]] occurs; one of the casualties of the event is the [[Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth|Caliginous Automaton]] on the planet [[Tomo-Reth]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[14,500 BBY]]
**The [[Third Alsakan Conflict]] begins with the [[Commenor Run Campaign]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[14,450 BBY]]
**The [[Cleansing of Rucapar]] occurs, a battle that sees the [[Alsakan Mosaics]] in the city of Rucapar destroyed by Republic forces.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[14,300 BBY]]
**The Third Alsakan Conflict comes to an end; during the final stages of fighting, the [[Duros Red Credit Brigade]] is defeated.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Nikato's Bootheel]] is established around the planet [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[14,000 BBY]]
**A number of Sith establish a [[library-temple]] on the world of [[Krayiss II]] where they slumber and their [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] haunt the temple for the next 10,000 years.<ref name="Tale Dark Side">{{WEGCite|story=A Tale from the Dark Side|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>
**The [[House Korden|Korden family]] first appears.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
**Duros scouts discover the planet [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]] and the [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]] species in the Expansion Region.<ref name="Alien Anthology" />
*c. [[13,800 BBY]]
**The [[Fourth Alsakan Conflict]] begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[13,649 BBY]]
**The [[Defence of Drogheda]] takes place.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[13,220 BBY]]
**The [[Conquest of Manaan]] occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[13,200 BBY]]
**The Fourth Alsakan Conflict comes to an end.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[13,050 BBY]]
**The [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]] begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[13,000 BBY]]
**The [[Herglic Trade Empire]] joins the Republic, sparking development around the [[Hidakai Pool]] route.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Ailon/Legends|Ailon]] becomes a member of the Republic.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
*[[12,980 BBY]]
**[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hirken]] defends Alsakani colonies in the Northern Dependencies, a campaign that was a major turning point in the conflict.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[12,720 BBY]]
**The planet [[Pelagon]] in the future [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] is first settled by large colony ships, and the colonists soon settle other worlds in the region.<ref name="LotE" />
*c. [[12,700 BBY]]
**The [[Resistance on Cyrillia]] occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />
**The Fifth Alsakan Conflict comes to an end.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[12,293 BBY]]
**An expedition led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Beramsh]] conducts the first surveys of the planet [[Tandun III]].<ref name="Millennium">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
*c. [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]
**Ithorian herdships make first contact with the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] is settled by explorers and colonists from Corellia, and the planet becomes an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] that later serves as a basis for the [[Great Northern Crusade|Seventh Pius Dea Crusade]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**Starting from the planet [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], scouts start to establish the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] route, bridging the gap between the Republic and Hutt Space.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Haddius Korden]], a successful merchant from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], turned his family business into [[Korden Outfitting and Surveying]], which supplied a wide variety of equipment to colonists headed for the farthest frontiers of the known galaxy.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />

==[[Pius Dea Era]] (11,987 BBY-10,966 BBY)==
*[[11,987 BBY]]
**[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pers'lya]] is impeached by the [[Pius Dea]], a religious sect who install the Human adherent [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex]]. Contispex's election begins the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,965 BBY]]
**Contispex I sanctions a military invasion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]&mdash;the [[First Pius Dea Crusade]]. The crusade is the first of a series of [[Pius Dea Crusades]] that are military crusades against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] by the increasingly-Pius Dea Galactic Republic.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,947 BBY]]
**Contispex I steps down as Supreme Chancellor and is succeeded by his son [[Contispex II]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,939 BBY]]
**Contispex II sanctions the [[Third Pius Dea Crusade]], yet another invasion of Hutt Space.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,933 BBY]]
**The Jedi Order retreats to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and severs all ties with the Pius Dea&ndash;dominated Republic, beginning their [[Recusal]]. A number of Jedi who are loyal to the Pius Dea form the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]] and settle on the planet [[Garn/Legends|Garn]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,920 BBY]]
**The [[Fourth Pius Dea Crusade]] begins against the Hutts.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,884 BBY]]
**The Seventh Pius Dea Crusade, also known as the Great Northern Crusade, begins against the Zabrak and other species native to the northern region of the galaxy.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[11,820 BBY]]
**The [[Sixth Alsakan Conflict]] begins as the Alsakani ally with the Duros, Herglics, and the Hutts against the Pius Dea-controlled Republic; however, the conflict ends with a Republic victory.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,791 BBY]]
**The Tenth Pius Dea Crusade, also known as the [[Crusade of the Wilds]], begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,708 BBY]]
**The [[Colonial Era]] of the Tapani sector ends, beginning the [[Twelve Kingdoms Era]].<ref name="LotE" />
*[[11,707 BBY]]
**The [[Eleventh Pius Dea Crusade]] against the Herglics begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,660 BBY]]
*The [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade]] against the [[Zarracine]]s and the [[Teirasan]]s begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
**Republic forces conduct an orbital [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|bombardment]] of [[Zarracina III]], turning its surface into an irradiated wasteland and forcing the native Zarracines into a nomadic existence.<ref name="Tinker Tailor">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
*11,600s BBY
**Republic citizens fleeing the Pius Dea settle the planet [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,591 BBY]]
**The [[Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade]] against the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,198 BBY]]
**The [[Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade]] against the Bothans and the Lanniks begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[11,100 BBY]]
**The [[Inquisition]]s begin in the Core Worlds and the Colonies, and the Jedi Order end their Recusal.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[11,057 BBY]]
**The [[Thirty-Fourth Pius Dea Crusade]] against the Hutts begins.<ref name="Warfare" />
*10,970s BBY
**The Renunciate Admiral [[Pers Pradeux]] discovers Prefsbelt IV and makes it a retreat for Renunciate naval officers in their efforts to overthrow the Pius Dea.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[10,967 BBY]]
**The Renunciation: The [[Renunciates|Renunciate]] movement, a splinter faction of the Pius Dea that has renounced their faith, reveals itself and allies with the Alsakani, Caamasi, and the Jedi Order. This splits the Pius Dea faith from within, pitting the Faithful against those who have abandoned the faith, and signals the start of the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]].<ref name="Warfare" />
**Renunciate forces clash with Faithfuls at Fondor, Ixtlar, and Cyrillia, supported by the Jedi, Alsakani, Duros, Herglics, and Hutts.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[10,966 BBY]]
**The [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] seed the Republic Navy with rogue navicomputer codes, which forces the Pius Dea's ships to jump randomly to hyperspace and become lost forever.<ref name="Warfare" />
**At the [[Battle of Uquine]], the Renunciate forces annihilate the remaining Pius Dea ships. The Jedi capture [[Contispex XIX]] aboard the ''[[Flame of Sinthara]]'', taking him to Caamas where he stands trial and is imprisoned.<ref name="Warfare" />

==[[Ductavis Era]] (10,966 BBY-9000 BBY)==
*10,966 BBY
**[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Biel Ductavis]] assumes the position of Supreme Chancellor; his ascension heralds the end of the Pius Dea era and the start of the [[Ductavis Era]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[10,000 BBY]]
**The historian [[Vicendi]] compiles a list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] for his [[Arturum Galactinum]], a work commissioned for the Republic's anniversary.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] enters the Galactic Republic. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] species begin to record their history. {{Circa}}<ref name="Essential Alien" />
**[[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]] is settled as a religious retreat by colonists from [[Thokos]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Kumauri Empire]] comes into [[Battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic|conflict]] with the Republic, deploying planet-busting battleships with mass drivers, though they are defeated. {{Circa}}<ref name="Warfare" />
**The planet [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] and its [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] inhabitants are discovered by Corellian traders. {{Circa}}<ref name="Coruscant and Core" />
**[[Madilon]] is discovered and becomes a principle component in [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] manufacturing. {{Circa}}<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
*[[9757 BBY]]
**The [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] participate in the [[Second Herglic Feud]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*9400s BBY
