**Planetary shielding begins to see widespread use across the galaxy.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[9349 BBY]]
**The Korden family officially becomes the noble House Korden.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
*9200s BBY
**Planetary turbolasers are first commonly deployed around this time.<ref name="Warfare" />

==[[Rianitus Period]] (9000 BBY-8000 BBY)==
*[[9000 BBY]]
**The [[Rianitus Period]] begins.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Jiroch-Reslia]] joins the Galactic Republic. {{Circa}}<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

==[[Subterra Period]] (8000 BBY-7000 BBY)==
*[[8000 BBY]]
**The [[Subterra Period]] begins.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] becomes a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] is colonized by the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy 3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref>
**[[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] is discovered by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] pirates.<ref name="Goroth" />
**The star [[Colu/Legends|Colu]] expands, swallowing the planet [[Clak'dor I]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Geonosis" />
*[[7811 BBY]]
**The [[Waymancy Storm]] occurs&mdash;a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. The victorious Republic reverse-engineered the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]]'s power generator technology to develop far more powerful turbolaser weaponry.<ref name="Warfare" />
*7700s BBY
**The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] master crafter [[Lyns Skutroo]] pioneers the [[squintpipe process]] for power generators, having reverse-engineered the Waymancy Hollow technology. As a result, shielding technology become important in combat, evolving from simply protection against environmental phenomena.<ref name="Warfare" />
*7500s BBY
**Further refinement of the squintpipe process allows for increases in shield power and regeneration.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[7348 BBY]]
**The [[Twelve Kingdoms]] Era of the [[Expanse]] comes to an end as the warlord [[Shey Tapani]] begins the [[Unification War]] to unite the worlds of the region.<ref name="LotE" />
*[[7328 BBY]]
**The Unification War ends at the [[battle of Shindra's Veil]], and Shey Tapani unites the Expanse under the banner of the [[Tapani Empire]]. He establishes his new government on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]], and also dedicates the [[Shey Tapani University/Legends|Shey Tapani University]] on [[Estalle Island]] shortly after the Empire's founding.<ref name="LotE" />
*[[7308 BBY]]
**The Tapani Empire establishes a university system on the planet [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]], which was recently discovered by Republic and Tapani scouts.<ref name="LotE" />
*[[7003 BBY]]
**The [[Second Great Schism]] occurs as a number of Dark Jedi split from the Jedi Order.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />

==[[Manderon Period]] (7000 BBY-5000 BBY)==
*[[7000 BBY]]
**[[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] joins the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
**[[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] initiates a period of civil war on Korriban<ref name="Atlas" /> upon ascending to the throne.<ref name="Korriban">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban|text=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|int=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls}}</ref>
**The [[Manderon Period]] begins.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] begins in the aftermath of the Second Great Schism.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**The [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]] leads his followers from the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] to a new world, which his followers rename [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in his honor. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**Republic scouts discover the Quermian system, where the Quermians have settled numerous worlds; within a few decades, the Quermians are active participants in the galactic community.<ref name="Alien Anthology" />
**The Sith library [[Veeshas Tuwan]] is established on [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]].<ref name="Essential Alien" />
*[[6950 BBY]]
**Dathka Graush's reign comes to an end with his death at the hands of assassins.<ref name="Korriban" />
*[[6900 BBY]]
**The Hundred-Year Darkness comes to an end with the [[Battle of Corbos]]. The defeated Dark Jedi are [[Exiles|exiled]] from the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Exiles [[Discovery of Korriban|discover]] the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] on Korriban, which they quickly conquer and transform into a Force-using magocracy.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Ajunta Pall]] becomes the first [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
*[[6740 BBY]]
**The crystal world of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] is discovered by the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
*6700s BBY
**The Mandalorians drive the [[Fenelar]] species to extinction after raiding the planet [[Fenel]], and they arm themselves with Fenelar technology.<ref name="Warfare" />
*6100s BBY
**The planet [[Tlön]] is depopulated and its surface largely incinerated by this time after centuries of conflict between the Mandalorians and the [[Tlönian]]s.<ref name="Warfare" />
*6100 BBY
**The planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] is first colonized.<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[6000 BBY/Legends|6000 BBY]]
**The planet [[Ession]] has been settled by this time.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Intelligent life appears on the planet [[Altiria/Anarris|Altiria]] in the form of the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]] and [[Anarrian]]s.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
*[[5975 BBY]]
**The planet [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], home of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], joins the Republic.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
*c. [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]]
**The [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] is established by [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] theorists, ushering in widespread colonization of the southern galaxy.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] is fully established, extending the ancient hyperroute that links Corellia and Duro all the way out to the edge of the galaxy.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[5451 BBY]]
**The [[Pathandr Fury]] occurs as the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] raid Republic settlements.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[5300 BBY]]
**The Jedi Order establishes a training center on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[5130s BBY]]
**The [[Nakat Incursions]], a border conflict instigated by the Mandalorians, occurs.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[5103 BBY]]
**The child [[Tenebrae]] kills his father, Lord [[Dramath]], and embarks on a conquest of Nathema.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
*[[5100 BBY/Legends|5100 BBY]]
**[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]] appoints Tenebrae ruler of Nathema, granting him the title of Lord Vitiate.<ref name="Revan" />
*[[5010 BBY]]
**[[Teta/Legends|Teta]] ascends to the throne of the planet Koros Major, and soon begins the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]] in an attempt to unite the seven worlds of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] under her rule.<ref name="Atlas" />

==[[Post-Manderon period]] (5000 BBY-4000 BBY)==
*[[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]
**The Unification Wars come to an end, with the Koros system united under [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] Teta's rule.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] enters an ice age. {{Circa}}
**Marka Ragnos dies, prompting a [[Funeral of Marka Ragnos|duel]] between the rival Sith Lords [[Ludo Kressh]] and [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], who both seek to succeed Ragnos. As Ragnos's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] looks on, Sadow emerges victorious and is anointed the new Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="Golden Age">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref>
**The [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]&mdash;a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire&mdash;erupts when two young hyperspace scouts, [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]], accidentally make contact with the Sith.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Manderon Period ends.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Sadow instigates the Great Hyperspace War in hopes of conquering the Republic, invading major Republic worlds such as Coruscant and the Koros system along the [[Daragon Trail]] hyperlane.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Dark Reaper]] is constructed. {{Circa}}
**[[Holocron of King Adas]] is lost on the planet [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]] following the death of its owner, Lord [[Garu]].<ref name="Evil Never Dies">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>
**Sadow's forces are ultimately driven back when his forces are revealed to be largely illusions, and Sadow flees back to the Sith Empire, where he is confronted by Ludo Kressh.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Sadow escapes after destroying Kressh's fleet just ahead of a Republic fleet pursuing him, and ultimately finds refuge on the moon of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Sith starship ''[[Omen]]'' crashes on the remote planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], stranding its crew as the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], while its sister ship [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] is thrown into the future and arrives around [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>
**Supreme Chancellor [[Pultimo]] orders an invasion of the Stygian Caldera to wipe out the remains of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Atlas" />
**A supernova occurs in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], forming the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**Duros scouts discover the planet [[Adnerem]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Alien Encounters">{{JournalCite|11|Alien Encounters}}</ref>
**Csilla undergoes an ice age, blanketing its surface with glaciers and forcing the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] species to move underground. {{Circa}}<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**The symbol of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] is carved into the moon of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], earning it the name of the [[Mascot Moon]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Hearing">{{WEGCite|story=The Hearing|book=Dark Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
**The [[Star Cabal]] is founded. {{Circa}}
*[[4999 BBY]]
**Vitiate calls the remaining Sith Lords of the Empire to his homeworld of Nathema, where he binds their wills to his own and conducts a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|powerful ritual]] of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]]. The [[Ritual of Nathema]] strips the Force from the entire planet, killing everyone on the world except Vitiate; Vitiate is made immortal and immensely powerful, becoming the Sith Emperor.<ref name="Revan" />
**Blaming Nathema's destruction on the Jedi, the Sith Emperor gathers the remains of the Empire and embarks on a length [[Sith exodus|exodus]] from Sith Space.<ref name="Revan" />
*[[4985 BBY]]
**Ravilan Wroth poisons a Keshiri village with [[cyanogen silicate]] in an attempt to encourage the Lost Tribe to escape from Kesh, but Seelah Korsin poisons more villages and frames Wroth for the massacre. Wroth and the fifty-seven remaining pureblood Sith are executed as a result.<ref name="Paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref>
*[[4980 BBY]]
**The Sith exiles arrive on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where the Sith Emperor establishes a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Revan" />
*[[4975 BBY]]
**The [[Skyborn Rangers]] are founded.
**Yaru Korsin dies following an uprising led by his wife Seelah, and his daughter Nida succeeds him as Grand Lord.<ref name="Savior">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior]]''</ref>
*[[4960 BBY]]
**Nida Korsin bears a son named [[Donellan]].<ref name="Purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref>
*c. [[4904 BBY]]
**[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Odile Vaiken]]'s [[Odile Vaiken's final campaign|final campaign]] against alien species ends with his death.<ref name="Timeline 11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref>
*[[4896 BBY]]
**[[Nida Korsin]]'s seventy-nine-year reign as [[Grand Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] ends with her death.<ref name="Pantheon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pantheon]]''</ref>
*[[4800 BBY]]
**The [[Gank Massacres]] begin: with the discovery of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]], the newly-discovered [[Porporite]] species is whipped into a homicidal frenzy by the spice, prompting various factions to hire mercenaries from the [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] species to protect them. The Gank exterminated the Porporites and went on a violent rampage of their own.<ref name="NEC" />
*[[4789 BBY]]
**Master Jumper [[Barkin (Galactic Republic)|Barkin]] leads a group of Republic rocket-jumpers on a combat mission during the Gank Massacres.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*[[4775 BBY]]
**The Gank Massacres are brought to an end by Jedi Knights and the [[Juggernaut war droid]]s, droids commissioned by Chancellor [[Vocatara]] to assist the Republic against the Ganks.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*c. [[4645 BBY]]
**The Sith Lord [[Darth Drear]] establishes a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]], under which he builds a secret temple to store his [[Darth Drear's holocron|holocron]].<ref name="Red Harvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>
*[[4606 BBY]]
**The Sith Lord [[Kel'eth Ur]] is [[Death/Legends|killed]] for his heretical [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] teachings by the Sith Emperor, and his body is entombed in the [[Dark Temple]] on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Buried Power">{{TORcite|type=general|Buried Power|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
*c. [[4600 BBY]]
**Roughly around this time, a group of Jedi including the Duinuogwuin [[Willm Lywin]] establish the [[Teyan Praxeum]] on the planet [[Teya IV]].<ref name="Dangerous">{{JournalCite|11|The Most Dangerous Foe}}</ref>
*[[4598 BBY]]
**The core of the [[Black Codex]] is created.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

*c. [[4500 BBY]]
**Parties from the Republic begin to contact the planet Kamino, seeking to make use of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]' exceptional cloning technology.<ref name="Atlas" />
**By this time, Republic scouts had discovered the star systems of the future [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Altiri and Anarrians come into contact with each other, sparking a global conflict that lasts for almost six hundred years.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**An independent scout vessel drops out of hyperspace too close to the gravity well of the planet [[Iol]], causing the pilot to crash on the planet and inadvertently uncovering a large vein of ore used in the creation of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. The pilot names the planet Iol and submits a claim to the world, but [[Tangan Industries]] intercepts and modifies his claim to give the company rights to the world.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**The [[Barabel War]], a millennia-long conflict among the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] species, erupts due to disputes over hunting grounds on their homeworld of [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]].<ref name="New Essential Alien" />
**[[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King]] [[Morn (king)|Morn]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] became the first ruler to unite the Mon Calamari and Quarren people under one monarchy.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
*c. [[4498 BBY]]
**Tangan Industries has completed a full mining colony on Iol, which expands into three cities scattered across the planet over the next few centuries.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
*[[4400 BBY]]
**After being denied Knighthood, a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Freedon Nadd]] explores the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] and encounters Naga Sadow's spirit, who sways Nadd to the dark side of the Force. Nadd kills Sadow's spirit and establishes himself as a king on the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], where he institutes a policy to banish criminals into the wilds beyond the walls of the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. Nadd establishes a dynasty of dark side-wielding monarchs.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**The exiled criminals manage to tame Onderon's wild beasts to become the [[Beast Riders]], and the Beast Riders wage war on Iziz, sparking the [[Beast Wars]].<ref name="NEC" />
**The Mon Calamari of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] begin to launch starliners to colonize planets around their homeworld over the next two centuries. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**Around this time, a team of Jedi Knights including the Devaronian [[Chamma]] are sent to investigate a distress call on the planet [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]]. There, the group is attacked by Sith devotees, and Chamma succumbs to the dark side during the encounter. Disappointed in his failure, Chamma goes into self-imposed exile on [[H'ratth]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Tales Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
*[[4300 BBY/Legends|4300 BBY]]
**The [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] Jedi Master [[Noab Hulis]] arrives on H'ratth and speaks with Chamma, convincing him to return to the light and end his exile.<ref name="Tales Companion" />
*[[4250 BBY]]
**The [[Third Great Schism]] erupts as Dark Jedi wage war against their fellows on Coruscant. The Dark Jedi are eventually driven off-world and retreat to the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]], where their attempt to harness the power of the [[Cosmic Turbine]] ends in the [[Vultar Cataclysm]]&mdash;the annihilation of the entire [[Vultar]] system.<ref name="NEC" />
**The [[Wingmaw/Legends|wingmaw]] and its primary predator, the [[Balmorran maweater]], are accidentally carried from their [[Unidentified Balmorran island chain|home island chain]] to the mainland of the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Wingmaw">{{TORcite|type=codex|Wingmaw}}</ref>
*c. 4241 BBY
**[[Suudaa Nem'ro]] is born on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref>{{TORcite|Conversation with Archiban Kimble: "So Near, Yet So Far"|type=}}</ref>
*[[4225 BBY]]
**The [[Kaikieli Reconquista]]&mdash;Jedi Master [[Vandar Tokare]] and his two Padawans lead Republic troops in conquering the corrupt world of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].<ref name="Tinker Tailor" />
*c. [[4200 BBY]]
**The [[Mecrosa Order]] is founded on [[Nyssa]] by [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscountess]] [[Mireya]], though the organization is corrupted&mdash;allegedly by Mireya herself&mdash;by Sith teachings over the next two centuries.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**The planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] is first settled by offworlders.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] seeks to be admitted to the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] becomes a haven for the [[Lorell Raiders]], a group of pirates who prowl the Perlemian for generations.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]] is colonized by pilgrims from [[Ator/Legends|Ator]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. 4100s BBY
**New navicomputer technology begins to render jump-beacons obsolete.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[4166 BBY]]
**The Mon Calamari species makes first contact with the Republic when Republic scouts encounter Mon Calamari starships near [[Ruisto]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Darvannis]] is discovered by spice smugglers in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Darvannis">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darvannis}}</ref>
*[[4129 BBY]]
**The [[Luire system]] is discovered and surveyed by the Republic.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
*c. [[4100 BBY]]
**[[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]] is introduced to the galaxy, becoming a competitor to [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[4086 BBY]]
**''[[Trampeta's Star Guide]]'' is first published.<ref name="New Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
*[[4085 BBY]]
**A vintage of wine that will become known as the particularly rare Ord Mantell 432 BTC is produced on Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" />
*[[4070 BBY]]
**[[Amanoa]], future queen of Onderon and wife of [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]], is born.<ref name="Beast Wars 1">[[Tales of the Jedi 1|''Tales of the Jedi'' 1]]</ref>
*[[4067 BBY]]
**The Republic exploration vessel [[Starveil (starship)|''Starveil'']] is lost while performing a study of the Luire system; the ship's last communication indicates that the crew planned to land on the fifth planet [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], but the ship is never found.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
*c. [[4056 BBY]]
**The [[Dynamet Corporation]] donates a large sum of credits to the hospital [[Dynamet General Hospital|Mercy General]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] for the construction of a wing devoted to curing the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. The hospital is renamed Dynamet General in thanks.<ref name="Dynamet General">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dynamet General}}</ref>
**Around this time, [[Tarisian Civil War|civil war]] breaks out between Taris's nobility and the planet's largely [[Alien/Legends|alien]] lower class. The conflict is sparked when rising levels of toxic pollution poison the planet's oceans and famine sweeps the city-world, and the nobility begin to hoard food for themselves. Though the lower classes rise up against the nobility, the rebellion is ultimately crushed after millions died in the fighting.<ref name="KOTOR" />
*c. [[4050 BBY]]
**Scouts from the planet [[Shor]] discover the planet [[Giaca]].<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**[[Drokko Kira]] is banished from the city of Iziz for challenging the dark side legacy of Freedon Nadd.<ref name="Beast Wars 2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref>
*c. [[4043 BBY]]
**The [[Dark Council]]ors [[Darth Victun]] and [[Darth Qalar]] fight a [[Kaggath (c. 4043 BBY)|Kaggath]] that destroys the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]], and both Sith are killed by the rest of the Council when it ends in a draw.<ref name="Imperial Citadel">{{TORcite|type=codex|Imperial Citadel}}</ref>
**The Sith Lord [[Darth Nostrem]] rebuilds the Imperial Citadel according to the Emperor's designs, and is cast into its depths upon its completion.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*[[4030 BBY]]
**[[Arca Jeth]] and a number of Jedi Knights devastate the Lorell Raiders at the [[Battle of Lorell]], forcing the survivors to retreat to the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The Raiders and their female prisoners eventually evolve into the matriarchal and isolationist [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].<ref name="New Essential Alien" />
*[[4024 BBY]]
**The [[Nevoota Extinction]] begins as the Mandalorians attack the planet [[Nevoota (planet)|Nevoota]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[4021 BBY]]
**The Nevoota Extinction ends with the extermination of the insectoid [[Nevoota/Legends|Nevoota]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[4020 BBY]]
**The [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] discovers [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the homeworld of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species, and claims the planet while renaming it "Edean."<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[4017 BBY]]
**The Mandalorian Crusaders attack the planet [[Basilisk]] in the [[Battle of Basilisk]]. The [[Basiliskan]]s are supported by Republic reinforcements under Jedi Master [[Sidrona Diath]], but ultimately are overrun and seed their own homeworld with toxins to deny it to the Mandalorians.<ref name="Warfare" />
**The Mandalorians retreat from Basilisk, but take numerous Basiliskans, Basiliskian warships, and [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] with them.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[4015 BBY]]
**The [[Great Droid Revolution]]: the Czerka assassin droid [[HK-01]] seizes power by subverting the programming of thousands of droids and turning them against their masters. Jedi intervention finally brings the conflict to an end after three months.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[4009 BBY]]
**The [[Systino]] crime syndicate discovers the planet [[244Core|Sraato]], a world rich in valuable natural resources. The Systino syndicate dominates most of the criminal activity in the sector for the next two hundred years.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
*[[4008 BBY]]
**The Jedi [[Jev Sunrider]] dies on [[Krayiss II]].<ref>Andur Sunrider leaves [[H'ratth]] for [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[3999 BBY]] per [[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]. The ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' says that 2 years prior (4001 BBY), Andur went to H'ratth, and six years prior to that (4007 BBY), he saw the Force ghost of his grandfather Jev, who the Companion says disappeared on a mission a year prior to that (4008 BBY). If you start at 3999 and count back the number of years (2, then 6, then 1) you arrive at 4008 BBY, which has to be the year of Jev's death, given that he appeared to Andur in ghost form a year later (4007 BBY).</ref>
*[[4007 BBY]]
**The [[Quesaya Border Conflict]] erupts, and the Republic rocket-jumpers play a role in ending the conflict.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
**Jev Sunrider's Force ghost appears to his grandson [[Andur Sunrider]] on [[Darada]] and warns him that he will play an important part in the coming war.<ref name="Tales Companion" />
*[[4004 BBY]]
**The Jedi Master [[Thon]] takes on [[Oss Wilum]] as his Padawan on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].<ref name="Tales 4">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref>
*[[4003 BBY]]
**The [[Giju Run/Legends|Giju Passage]] is blazed by Herglic scouts, and within twenty-five years the route becomes an established trade route into Herglic space.<ref name="Player Tapani">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>
*[[4002 BBY]]
**The Mandalorians attack the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet [[Kuar]] and [[Battle of Kuar|conquer]] the world.<ref name="Warfare" />
**Onderon makes contact with the Galactic Republic and encounters galactic civilization.<ref name="Beast Wars 1" />
*[[4001 BBY]]
**Andur Sunrider arrives on the planet [[H'ratth]] and begins his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] under Master Chamma.<ref name="Tales Companion" />

==[[Old Sith Wars]] (4000 BBY-3950 BBY)==
*[[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]
**The [[Kyyr system]] is enveloped in a supernova, forming the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]] and [[Thornhedge Pulsar|Pulsar]] and also devastating the ''Ootmian Pabol''. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Ession]] is colonized. {{Circa}}<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
**The [[Exchange]] is founded. {{Circa}}
**The [[Omwati]] establish a colony on Coruscant.
**[[Muzara]] is colonized.
**[[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station]] is established on the planet [[Flashpoint (planet)|Flashpoint]].<ref name="Flashpoint">{{CSWECite|I|279|Flashpoint}}</ref>
**Jedi Master [[Arca Jeth]] sends his three apprentices, [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], [[Cay Qel-Droma]], and [[Tott Doneeta]], to Onderon in order to bring an end to the ongoing Beast Wars. Their mission soon goes awry when Princess Galia is kidnapped during a Beast Rider [[Raid on the Iziz Royal Palace|raid]] on Iziz. The Jedi pursue Galia, only to discover that she intends to marry the Beast Rider [[Oron Kira]], and Onderon's royal family are practitioners of the dark side.<ref name="NEC" />
**Their attempts to negotiate a peace with Queen Amanoa fail when she unleashes the dark side against them, and the Beast Riders lay [[Battle of Iziz|siege]] to Iziz. Arca Jeth arrives and lends his [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to the Beast Riders, bringing about their victory, and his powerful presence in the light side causes Freedon Nadd's spirit to abandon Queen Amanoa and leave her to die. Galia and Kira are [[Binding Ceremony of Oron Kira and Galia|married]] and assume the throne of Onderon.<ref name="NEC" />
*[[3999 BBY]]
**[[Nomi Sunrider]] becomes Thon's apprentice after the death of her husband Andur.<ref name="Saga">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Saga of Nomi Sunrider]]''</ref>
*[[3998 BBY]]
**The [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] erupts on Onderon as King Ommin leads an [[Army/Legends|army]] of dark side-empowered [[Naddist]]s against the Jedi Order and Beast Riders. The Naddists [[Funeral of Amanoa|interrupt]] Amanoa's [[Funeral of Amanoa|funeral]] and capture Arca Jeth, and also succeed in recovering the sarcophagi of both Amanoa and Freedon Nadd.<ref name="NEC" />
**The Galactic Republic and additional Jedi Knights arrive on Onderon and [[Second Battle of Onderon|engage]] Ommin's army, and the Jedi ultimately defeat Ommin and liberate Arca Jeth. At the same time, the Tetan nobles [[Aleema Keto]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], who were visiting Ommin and learning Sith lore from the king, escape back to their home system of Empress Teta and become Freedon Nadd's new apprentices.<ref name="NEC" />
*[[3997 BBY]]
**The Keto cousins [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|stage a military and political coup]] in the Empress Teta system, seizing control of the system from their parents as they establish power around their [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]]. The coup begins the [[Krath Holy Crusade]].<ref name="DLS 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>
**A Republic and Jedi task force comes to the aid of the planet Empress Teta, which has managed to hold off the Krath, but the Sith cult drives the Republic out of the system at the [[Battle of Koros Major]]. Ulic Qel-Droma is infected by Aleema Keto's [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] during an attack on the Republic's command ship ''[[Reliance I]]'', and he unknowingly begins to slip towards the dark side.<ref name="DLS 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>
**The Jedi [[Conclave at Deneba]] is [[Battle of Deneba|disrupted]] by Krath war droids, and the servant droids at the conclave attack the Jedi at the event. The Jedi destroy their attackers, but Arca Jeth is killed by Krath droids in the battle.<ref name="DLS 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>
**Ulic Qel-Droma attempts to infiltrate the Krath from within, but is seduced to the dark side by Aleema Keto. Qel-Droma [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|kills]] Satal and becomes the Krath's leader alongside Aleema, and a Jedi [[Mission to Empress Teta|rescue mission]] fails when Qel-Droma refuses to depart.<ref name="DLS 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref>
**Around the same time, The power-hungry Jedi [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] searches for Sith teachings and discovers the spirit of Freedon Nadd on Onderon's moon [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], where he is trained in the ways of the dark side before heading to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to acquire more power. Kun ultimately kills Nadd's spirit and seeks out Ulic Qel-Droma to eliminate a potential rival.<ref name="DLS 4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>
**Nomi Sunrider organizes a [[Battle of Empress Teta|second rescue mission]] at the same time that Kun arrives on Empress Teta, and Kun and Qel-Droma clash in a [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|duel]]. However, the duel is ended by the spirit of Marka Ragnos, who anoints Kun and Qel-Droma as Dark Lords of the Sith as well as Master and apprentice. Joining forces with Kun, Qel-Droma refuses Sunrider's attempt at a rescue, and the two Sith form the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]].<ref name="DLS 6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref>
**Several [[slivilith]] - living probe creatures created by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] - appear in the galaxy.
*[[3996 BBY]]
**In the [[Duel on Kuar]] on the [[Plains of Harkul]], [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] defeats Mandalore the Indomitable in combat, winning his loyalty.
**Exar Kun locates and reactivates the [[Dark Reaper]], and begins using it to conquer planets.
**After months of conquering planets from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], the Sith launch their attack on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the battle, [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] is captured and subsequently put on trial for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].
**Mandalore the Indomitable is defeated by the Republic at the [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|Battle of Onderon]] and killed by the beasts of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. He is succeeded by [[Mandalore the Ultimate]].
**Sith Lord Ulic Qel-Droma turns away from the dark side.
**Exar Kun is defeated at the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|Battle of Yavin 4]] by Ulic Qel-Droma and the Republic.
**The Dark Reaper is deactivated and its power source, the [[Force Harvester]], is hidden on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].
**Both the Great Sith War and the Krath Holy Crusade end with the [[Recapture of the Empress Teta system]].
**Mandalore the Ultimate begins secretly summoning clans from across the galaxy, building up arms and ships on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], working toward the day when a new crusade can be launched.
**The Jedi Order create the [[Lost City of the Jedi]] to aide the recovery of the planet [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4's]] ecology as well as to ensure that [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] never returned again.
**An attack by the Sith devastates Mustafar&mdash;the gas giant [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]] is tugged out of its orbit by a dark side weapon, causing Mustafar to be caught between the gravitational fields of Lefrani and the gas giant [[Jestefad/Legends|Jestefad]]. All life on the planet's surface dies as the surface is ripped apart by immense tidal stresses.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Jedi Order relocates to Coruscant following Ossus's devastation.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3995 BBY]]
**The [[Restoration Period]] begins for the Republic.<ref name="KOTOR Campaign">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
**The [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], a Jedi campaign to eradicate the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]], begins.<ref name="NEC" />
*[[3994 BBY]]
**[[Carth Onasi]] is born on [[Telos IV]].
**Ulic Qel-Droma revisits Yavin 4 to learn what had happened to Exar Kun, but is unable to learn anything as to his former comrade's fate.<ref name="Sith War 6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>
**[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] is born on an unknown planet, believed to be somewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
*[[3993 BBY]]
**During the Great Hunt, Jedi Knights successfully [[Cleansing of Tatooine|cleanse]] the planet Tatooine of terentateks. The Great Hunt is officially ended, but the Jedi Council secretly dispatches three Knights&mdash;[[Duron Qel-Droma]], [[Shaela Nuur]], and [[Guun Han Saresh]]&mdash;to seek out and eradicate the last of the terentateks on Korriban.<ref name="Shadows and Light">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref>
**The trio's mission falls apart when Saresh, furious that Nuur and Qel-Droma are in a relationship, strikes out on his own and hunts down a terentatek on Kashyyyk. Saresh is [[Cleansing of Kashyyyk|killed]] by the terentatek, and Nuur and Qel-Droma are killed by their target in the caves of Korriban.<ref name="Shadows and Light" />
**[[Krynda Draay]], daughter of Noab Hulis and widow of [[Barrison Draay]], is roused from the depression that the Sith War put her in when she meets the Miraluka child [[Q'Anilia]]. Q'Anilia's powers of precognition impress the half-Miraluka seer, and inspires Draay to found a [[Jedi Covenant]] dedicated to preventing the rise of the Sith.<ref name="KOTOR 9">[[Knights of the Old Republic 9|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 9]]</ref>
*[[3988 BBY]]
**The [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoot]] [[Jarael|Edessa]] is born on Osadia.<ref name="KOTOR 46">[[Knights of the Old Republic 46|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 46]]</ref> Wyrick believes her to be his greatest success in the [[New Generation Project]], and her name&mdash;''Edessa'', or "triumph"&mdash;reflects that.<ref name="KOTOR 48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref>
**Krynda Draay receives a Force vision that becomes known as the [[Prophecy of the Five]]. The prophecy foretells five individuals&mdash;one for the light, one for the dark, one for the dark in the light, one for the light in the dark, and one who stands alone&mdash;that will play pivotal roles in the next great conflict in which "all that has been built will fall."<ref name="KOTOR 24">[[Knights of the Old Republic 24|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 24]]</ref>
*[[3986 BBY]]
**Nomi Sunrider, by now the head of the Jedi Order, calls a [[Conclave on Exis Station|conclave]] of the Order on [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]]. However, the conclave is interrupted when Nomi's daughter Vima steals an ion mining vessel and is nearly killed before Tott Doneeta rescues her. Vima seeks out Ulic Qel-Droma on Rhen Var and becomes his student, studying the ways of the Force.<ref name="NEC" />
**The Cathar Jedi [[Sylvar]] tracks down Ulic on Rhen Var and [[Duel on Rhen Var|attacks]] him for his crimes and the death of her master [[Crado]] during the Great Sith War. Their duel ends when Qel-Droma refuses to fight, freeing Sylvar from the grips of her rage; however, the spacer [[Hoggon]] shoots Qel-Droma moments later in hopes of gaining fame.<ref name="NEC" />
*[[3985 BBY]]
**The [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]] [[Coruscant Financial Exchange Establishment Act|Establishment act]] speeds the restoration of the devastated [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by allowing corporations to invest in the government's infrastructure in return for guaranteeing safe passage through increasingly treacherous hyperspace routes.<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
*[[3984 BBY]]
**[[Darth Xedrix]] begins to serve on the [[Dark Council]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Revan" />
*[[3982 BBY]]
**[[Zayne Carrick]] is born on [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]].
*[[3980 BBY]]
**Vima Sunrider makes an entry in the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]] regarding Ulic Qel-Droma's redemption and death.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
*[[3978 BBY]]
**Mandalore the Ultimate is influenced by an [[Unidentified Sith emissary|agent]] of the Sith Empire into waging war on the Republic.<ref name="Revan" />
*[[3977 BBY]]
**The planet [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]] is inducted into the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Zayne Carrick is discovered by the Jedi Order and brought to the [[Jedi Enclave]] on Dantooine.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref>
*[[3976 BBY]]
**The [[Mandalorian Wars]] begin with the [[Battle of Althir (first)|Battle of Althir]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**A [[Bek–Vulkar gang war|gang war]] erupts between the [[Hidden Beks]] and [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]], two [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] on Taris.<ref name="KOTOR" />
*[[3973 BBY]]<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
**[[Cassus Fett]] leads the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in the [[Battle of Cathar]]&mdash;Fett's forces wipe out over 90% of the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] population on their [[Cathar (location)/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
*[[3970 BBY]]
**[[Mission Vao]] is born on an unknown planet.
**Argazda's [[Governor/Legends|Provisional Governor]] [[Myrial]] declares the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] independent, renaming it the [[Argazdan Redoubt]] and instigating the bloody [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3969 BBY]]
**The First WatchCircle of the Jedi Covenant&mdash;[[Feln]], [[Lucien Draay]], Q'Anilia, [[Raana Tey]], and [[Xamar]]&mdash;are assigned five [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]: [[Oojoh]], Zayne Carrick, [[Shad Jelavan]], [[Kamlin]], [[Gharn]]. The five Padawans are transferred to the [[Jedi Tower]] on Taris, where their new Jedi Masters are stationed.<ref name="KOTOR 24" />
*[[3968 BBY]]
**[[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania]] begins offering "genetic solutions" to [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoot]] employees.<ref name="KOTOR 18">[[Knights of the Old Republic 18|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 18]]</ref>
*[[3967 BBY]]
**The Jedi Knight [[Jelph Marrian]] is expelled from the Order after alienating the Jedi Council, and he joins the Jedi Covenant as a [[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]].<ref name="Purgatory" />
*[[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]]
**The planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] is admitted to the Republic after a number of corporations, including [[Lhosan Industries]], successfully bribe Senators into admitting their world.<ref name="Warfare" />
**The parents of [[Shad Jelavan|Shad]], [[Shay Jelavan|Shay]], and [[Shel Jelavan]] are killed in an accident in the [[Middle City]] of Taris.<ref name="Prime">{{KOTORbackups|0}}</ref>
*[[3965 BBY]]
**The Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders first begin to combat the Republic Military as they move closer and closer to the Republic's edge, thus beginning the "False War."<ref name="Atlas" />
**Mission Vao and her brother, [[Griff Vao|Griff]], stow away on a ship to Taris.<ref name="KOTOR" />
*[[3964 BBY]]
**The Mandalorians clash with the Republic at the [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]] for several weeks.
**The [[First WatchCircle]] of the [[Jedi Covenant]] commits the [[Padawan Massacre]], the murder of their five Padawans on Taris, after the [[Rogue Moon Prophecy]] foretells a dark figure who will bring destruction to the galaxy&mdash;a figure they believe is one of their Padawans. The Padawan [[Zayne Carrick]] arrives late and escapes with the con man [[Marn Hierogryph]], but is framed for the Massacre.<ref name="KotOR1: C,P1">[[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]]</ref>
**Carrick escapes from the Jedi Tower after his capture, and his escape sparks rioting and mass panic across Taris as the public loses faith in the Jedi. Mandalore the Ultimate views this as a signal to attack and [[Battle of Vanquo|takes]] the planet [[Vanquo]] just as the year ends.
*[[3963 BBY]]
**The Mandalorians break through the Republic lines and begin the [[Taris Siege]], and proceed to invade the Republic through three separate corridors in what becomes known as the Onslaught. One of those corridors sees the [[Battle of Serroco|nuclear devastation]] of [[Serroco]], though the Mandalorians' offensives are all halted by the end of the year.
**[[Q'Anilia]] commits suicide after being led to believe that her mentor and mother figure, [[Krynda Draay]], had died.<ref name="KotOR34: V,P3">[[Knights of the Old Republic 34|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 34]]</ref>
**The [[Revanchist]]s, a group of young interventionist Jedi led by a charismatic Knight known as "the Revanchist", uncover evidence of the Battle of Cathar. In light of the Mandalorians' actions, the Jedi Council begrudgingly sanctions the Revanchists' entrance into the Mandalorian Wars, and the Revanchist adopts the name [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].
**A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] scout arrives in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
*[[3962 BBY]]
**The Mandalorian launch a Coreward campaign known as the [[Mandalorian Triumph]] that sees them breach the Core Worlds as far as Duro.<ref name="Atlas" /> However, Revan and his friend [[Darth Malak|Malak]] arrive at the [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|Battle of Duro]] with a fleet of [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruisers]], preventing the Mandalorians from escaping with war matériel. As a result, Supreme Chancellor [[Tol Cressa]] appoints Revan the [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] of the Republic Military.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[3961 BBY]]
**Over the course of this and the next year, Revan leads the Republic in rolling back the Mandalorians' advances, though often at the cost of civilians thanks to "moral shortcuts."
**[[Lillia Venn]] becomes Grand Lord on Kesh.<ref name="Purgatory" />
*[[3960 BBY]]
**The Mandalorian Wars come to an end at the [[Battle of Malachor V]], where Revan kills Mandalore the Ultimate and the [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]] wipes out most of the Mandalorian and Republic fleets while destroying the planet's surface.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[3959 BBY]]
**The '''[[Jedi Civil War]]''' begins.<ref name="KOTOR" />
**Turned to the dark side by the Sith Emperor, Revan and Malak find the Star Forge and, after breaking free of the Emperor's control, form their own Sith Empire to invade the Republic.
**The [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]] is constructed.
**[[Battle of Foerost (Jedi Civil War)|Battle of Foerost]].
**[[Bombing of Telos IV]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

*[[3957 BBY]]
**Revan is [[Capture of Darth Revan|captured]] onboard his flagship, after Malak turns against him. [[Bastila Shan]] brings Revan back to the Jedi, who use the Force to strip his memories and create a new identity for him.<ref name="KOTOR" />

*[[3956 BBY]]
**[[Destruction of Taris]] which results with most of the planet destroyed.<ref name="KOTOR" />
**Revan and Bastila along with their companions begin to look for the [[Star Map]]s spread across four planets ([[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]) after finding one on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
**[[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|Attack on Dantooine]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
**At the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]], Revan kills Malak in a lightsaber duel, and the Republic Fleet destroys the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
**End of the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
**The [[Sith Civil War]] begins.<ref name="NEC" />
**The [[Order of Shasa]] is founded on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].
*[[3955 BBY]]
**Sith Lords, formerly loyal to Darth Revan and Malak, begin breaking the Sith Empire into smaller domains, declaring themselves sovereign [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
**The [[Sith Triumvirate]] is formed.<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
**Supreme Chancellor [[Tol Cressa]] starts the [[Telosian Restoration Project]], for which the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] launches the [[G0-T0]] droid series.<ref name="New Droids" />
*[[3954 BBY]]
**[[First Jedi Purge]] begins.<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
**[[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]], under orders from [[Darth Sion]], begin a widespread assassination campaign against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who soon are all but wiped out.<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
**The remnants of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] are mostly unified by [[Kreia|Darth Traya]], [[Darth Sion]] and [[Darth Nihilus]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
**[[Vaner Shan]] is born.
**[[Darth Xedrix]] is killed by [[Scourge (Sith)|Lord Scourge]].<ref name="Revan" />

*[[3952 BBY]]
**The [[Conclave at Katarr|Conclave on Katarr]] is called to discuss the future of the Jedi Order.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
***[[Vandar Tokare]] dies.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] uses his massive Force powers to feed on the life on [[Katarr/Legends|Katarr]], [[Conclave at Katarr|destroying all life on the planet]] (except for the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Visas Marr]]) and virtually wipes out the Jedi Order.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

*[[3951 BBY]]
**[[Canderous Ordo]], known as Mandalore the Preserver, reunites the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans and aids in the fight against the remnants of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**The [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], though not entirely legal means, attempts to take control over the [[Telosian Restoration Project]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**[[Meetra Surik]] is discovered aboard the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' by [[Kreia]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**[[Lonna Vash]] dies.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**[[Battle of Khoonda]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
***[[Kavar]] dies.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
***[[Zez-Kai Ell]] dies.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
***[[Vrook Lamar]] dies.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**[[Blockade of Onderon]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**[[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|Second Battle of Onderon]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**[[Battle of Telos IV]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
***[[Darth Nihilus]] dies.<ref name="NEC" />
**Meetra Surik reestablishes connection to the Force, then kills [[Darth Nihilus]], [[Darth Sion]] and [[Kreia|Darth Traya]], who have spent the last five years assassinating Jedi.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**[[Battle of Malachor]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
***[[Darth Sion]] dies.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
***[[Kreia]] dies.<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
**[[First Jedi Purge]] ends.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
**End of the [[Old Sith Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />

==[[Inter-Sith Wars period]] (3950 BBY-2000 BBY)==
*[[3950 BBY]]
**[[Darth Nyriss]] is killed.<ref name="Revan" />
**The city of [[Bin Prime]] is chosen to replace [[Sobrik]] as the capital of Balmorra. {{Circa}}<ref name="Sobrik">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sobrik}}</ref>
**[[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Meetra Surik]], and the rogue Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] travel to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in a [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|daring attempt]] to try and kill the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. However, they are betrayed by Scourge. Surik is killed and Revan is taken prisoner. He would remain the Sith Emperor's captive for three centuries.<ref name="Revan" />
**The [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]] is created.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" /><ref name="Revan" />
*[[3946 BBY]]
**[[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system|G0-T0 droids]] seize control of sixteen worlds in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] and [[Secession of 400100500260026|secede]] from the Republic, forming the independent territory of [[400100500260026]]. However, Supreme Chancellor Tol Cressa organizes a [[Liberation of 400100500260026|military campaign]] that liberates the territory.<ref name="New Droids" />
*c. [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]]
**[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] sponsors one of the last colonization efforts by her world, but the colonization ships&mdash;the ''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'', ''[[Constant]]'', and ''[[Mother Vima]]''&mdash;disappear from sight. It is later discovered that the ships reached the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where they settled and came into conflict with the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="NEC" />
*c. [[3840 BBY|3841 BBY]]
**[[Karagga]] the Unyielding becomes [[Supreme Mogul]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]; he retains the position for nearly two centuries.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*[[3838 BBY]]
**[[Bowdaar]] is born on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
*c. [[3809 BBY]]
**Sraato sustains massive damage from a meteor storm, beginning a period of environmental chaos that lasts for five hundred years.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
*[[3756 BBY]]
**Jedi Master [[Barel Ovair]], actually a servant of the Sith Emperor, undertakes a mission with his apprentice [[Eison Gynt]] to Yavin 4. Ovair's true mission is to eliminate the spirit of Naga Sadow for the Emperor, but the two are attacked by Massassi and Ovair is forced to flee the moon, abandoning his apprentice. Gynt returns to Coruscant years later, under Sadow's possession, and is killed when he attacks Ovair.<ref name="Timeline 7">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?|int=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?}}</ref>
*c. [[3743 BBY]]
**The hunter [[Riegenn Hetuu]] delivers a live [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] queen to his [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|Hutt client]] on Nal Hutta, only to be consumed along with his client by the approximately four hundred k'lor'slugs that the queen had spawned in his ship. The incident gives rise to the term a "hutt's cry," referring to the sound made by a batch of hatching k'lor'slugs.<ref name="K'lor'slug">{{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}}</ref>
*[[3716 BBY|3717 BBY]]
**[[Darth Vowrawn]] is born.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*c. [[3712 BBY]]
**The Sith Lord [[Darth Ikoral]] is granted permission to take his flagship, the ''[[Red Reaper]]'', on an expedition in search of pureblooded Sith outside of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Ikoral">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darth Ikoral}}</ref>
*[[3708 BBY]]
**[[Hedarr Soongh]] becomes the youngest ever [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]].
*[[3707 BBY]]
**[[Eckard Lokin]] is born on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. {{Circa}}
*[[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]]
**The [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaalan]] hyperspace explorer [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] bridges the gap between the [[Mandalorian Road]] and the [[Sprizen End Run]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3704 BBY]]
**Freia Kallea blazes a route linking the [[Spurs of Celanon/Legends|Spurs of Celanon]] and the [[Morellian Trail]], completing the northern end of the Hydian Way.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3703 BBY|3703]]&ndash;[[3702 BBY]]
**Freia Kallea charts a route south from [[Denon/Legends|Denon]], linking the end of the [[Brentaal–Denon Route]] with the [[Dustig Trace]]. However, she crash-lands on the uncharted planet [[Nuvar]] thanks to interference from rivals, where she is stranded for six years.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3702 BBY]]
**[[Darth Marr]] is born.
*[[3701 BBY]]
**Kallea's route is expanded from the Dustig Trace to [[Seswenna/Legends|Seswenna]] and [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] to the south over several years.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Darth Malgus]] is born on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
*[[3697 BBY|3698 BBY]]
**[[Darth Baras]] is born.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*[[3697 BBY]]
**[[Gault Rennow]] is born allegedly on Coruscant.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*[[3696 BBY]]
**[[Elin Garza]] is born on Coruscant.
**[[Darth Thanaton]] is born.
*[[3694 BBY]]
**Rescued from Nuvar, Kallea extends her route all the way to [[Terminus/Legends|Terminus]] near the edge of the galactic disk, and then extends it further to [[Imynusoph/Legends|Imynusoph]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Rycus Kilran]] is born on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
*[[3693 BBY]]
**The fully-charted [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] is christened.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3688 BBY]]
**[[Darth Jadus]] is born.
*[[3683 BBY]]
**[[Jace Malcom]] joins the [[Republic Army]].
*[[3682 BBY]]
**[[Fideltin Rusk]] is born on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].
*[[3681 BBY]]
**The [[Great Galactic War]] officially begins when a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of Republic warships is [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|destroyed]] by an [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial armada]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], signifying the Sith's return to the known galaxy.
**[[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] is [[Battle of Korriban|reclaimed]] by the Sith.
**The Empire begins a [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockade]] of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].
**[[Darth Marr]] joins the [[Dark Council]].
*[[3680 BBY]]
**[[Malavai Quinn]] is born on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
**The [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route]] comes to an end with the Republic's victory during the [[Second battle of the Seswenna sector]].
*[[3678 BBY]]
**[[Syo Bakarn]] is born on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. {{Circa}}
**The Republic tries to [[Battle over Korriban|recapture]] Korriban after receiving info from the rogue Sith apprentice [[Exal Kressh]], but are unable to recapture the Sith holy world. Kressh is eventually hunted down and executed for treason.
*[[3676 BBY]]
**[[Tanno Vik]] is born on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
*[[3675 BBY]]
**[[Qyzen Fess]] is born.
*[[3673 BBY]]
**[[Felix Iresso]] is born on [[Rehemsa]].
**[[Aric Jorgan]] is born on [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]].
*[[3672 BBY]]
**[[Tharan Cedrax]] is born on [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]].
**[[Kaliyo Djannis]] is born on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. {{Circa}}
*[[3671 BBY]]
**[[Pierce]] is born on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].
**The Republic score their first major victory against the Sith Empire at the [[First Battle of Bothawui]]. The Empire would send a much larger force to Bothawui after their initial defeat and faced the Republic in a [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second battle]] considered to the the bloodiest battle in the war up to that point; the battle ultimately ended in a stalemate.
*[[3670 BBY]]
**[[Archiban Frodrick Kimble]] is born on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].
**[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] is invaded by the Sith Empire.
**The Jedi finally liberate the Kanz sector from the Myrialites, ending the Kanz Disorders.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3667 BBY]]
**[[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] sponsors a Mandalorian [[Mandalore the Lesser|gladiator]] in hopes of using him to rally the Mandalorians to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] side. Eventually, after a string of fixed victories, the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] is given the ancient title of Mandalore by cheering crowds in a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] arena.<ref name="Timeline 4">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref>
**[[Darth Malgus]] leads an [[Battle of Alderaan|attack]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to try and gain a foothold for the Sith Empire in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The attack fails due to the efforts of [[Havoc Squad]] and [[Satele Shan]].
*[[3666 BBY]]
**[[Raina Temple]] is born on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
*[[3665 BBY]]
**[[Corso Riggs]] is born on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
**The Sith Empire win a critical victory at the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]].
*[[3664 BBY]]
**[[Jaesa Willsaam]] is born on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
**[[Nadia Grell]] is born on [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]].
*[[3663 BBY]]
**[[Kira Carsen]] is born on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
**[[Lemda Avesta]] is born on [[Makeb]].<ref name="Shelter">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Shelter from the Storm|Makeb}}</ref>
*[[3662 BBY]]
**[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] is born on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
**[[Mnah Ra'at]] is born.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
**[[Arra Yooms]] is born.<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>
**[[Ashara Zavros]] is born on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
*[[3661 BBY]]
**[[Mandalore the Lesser]] orders a fleet to [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].
*[[3660 BBY]]
**The [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]] comes to an end thanks to the efforts of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]], who ambushed the Mandalorian ships with a fleet of smuggling freighters.
**[[Torian Cadera]] is born on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].
**The [[Battle of Ord Radama]] takes place.
**[[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] is captured by the Sith Empire.
*[[3655 BBY]]
**[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] escapes from Nar Shaddaa.
*[[3653 BBY]]
**The Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|sacks]] Coruscant, destroying the Jedi Temple and inflicting mass casualties, including Supreme Chancellor [[Berooken]] and Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Zym]]. They hold the planet hostage as the Republic, who had been tricked into attending peace negotiations on Alderaan, are forced to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which ends the Great War, beginning the period of covert conflicts and private wars known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] .
**The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate is founded.
**[[Kira Carsen]] flees from [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] after learning that she is one of the [[Children of the Emperor]].
*[[3651 BBY]]
**[[Satele Shan]] rediscovers the planet of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], a deed that gains her the rank of Jedi Master, and later Grand Master following the death of Grand Master Zym, and the Order relocates to Tython.<ref name="Gnost-Dural">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>
*[[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]]
**The Jedi Order begins construction of a new [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython.<ref name="Gnost-Dural" />
*[[3648 BBY]]
**The Republic begins the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].<ref name="Operation Salvage">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Operation Salvage|Taris}}</ref>
*[[3647 BBY]]
**Construction of the Jedi Temple on Tython comes to a close.<ref name="Tython Jedi Temple">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jedi Temple (Tython)}}</ref>
*[[3645 BBY]]
**[[Kira Carsen]] is discovered on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by Jedi Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]], who decides to take the girl as her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner.
*[[3643 BBY]]
**The Cold War begins to collapse as a number of proxy conflicts erupt between the Republic and the Empire, such as [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|private war]] on the Republic, the [[Alderaan Civil War]], and the [[Separatist War]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
**The Mandalorians hold the sixth [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]], a galaxy-wide competition between [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and other competing warriors.
**[[Havoc Squad]] [[SpecForce Incident|defects]] to the Sith Empire.
**The [[Rift Alliance]] is founded.
*[[3642 BBY]]
**The [[Galactic War]] breaks out as the tense peace of the Cold War collapses.
**[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] is liberated by the Republic after nearly three decades of Imperial occupation.
**After spending three centuries as the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] captive, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] finally escapes from captivity during the [[Battle of the Maelstrom]]. [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] is killed during the battle.
**Revan captures the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]], an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] space station capable of mass-producing [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on a very large scale. However, an Imperial task force lead by [[Darth Malgus]] would catch up with Revan, and he would fall in combat.
*[[3640 BBY]]
**Supreme Chancellor [[Dorian Janarus]] is assassinated. [[Leontyne Saresh]], Governor of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], is elected as his successor.
**[[Darth Baras]] leads a [[Darth Baras's coup|coup]] of the Sith Empire, proclaiming himself to be the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]] after trapping the Emperor on [[Voss]]. Baras' coup would be thwarted after he was killed by [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]]. The apprentice is subsequently named the [[Emperor's Wrath]].
**The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] is seemingly killed by the [[Hero of Tython]] during a [[Dromund Kaas operation|battle]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] after his attempt to conduct a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] that would have consumed all life in the galaxy.
**[[Darth Malgus]] declares the formation of the [[New Empire]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. This prompts the Republic and Empire to temporarily put aside their differences and work together to defeat Malgus.
**Through [[Operation End Game]], the Republic destroys the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'', a prototype warship commanded by [[Darth Karrid]].<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>
*[[3638 BBY]]
**The [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], under the leadership of [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Toborro]], [[Conquest of Makeb|invades]] the neutral world of [[Makeb]] in order to harvest the [[isotope-5]] in the planet's core. The Republic lends the people of Makeb aid, while the weakened Empire undertakes a cover mission to secure isotope-5 reserves for themselves.
**The Empire manages to stabilize Makeb's core as it begins to tear the planet apart, saving the planet from complete destruction.
**The [[Dread Masters]] are finally eliminated on the moon of [[Oricon]].
*[[3637 BBY]]
**[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] dies for the final time on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
**The Sith Emperor Vitiate consumes all life on Ziost.
*[[3636 BBY]]
**The [[Eternal Empire]] reveals itself and begins its [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the galaxy.
**[[Alliance Commander|The Outlander]] is captured and frozen in carbonite.
*[[3630 BBY]]
**The [[Eternal Alliance]] is founded by [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] to oppose the Eternal Empire's rule of the galaxy.
**[[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] dies for the final time on [[Zakuul]].
**The [[third Galactic War]] commences.
**The third Galactic War ends some time prior to 3522 BBY
*c. [[3500 BBY]]
**Republic scouts discover the moon of [[Iktotchon/Legends|Iktotchon]], home of the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] species, and are astonished to see the seal of the Republic carved into a high plateau on the moon's largest continent. The precognitive Iktotchi predicted the Republic's arrival by several weeks, and the Iktotchi leaders have gathered at the massive carving for their first contact with other species.<ref name="Alien Anthology" />
*c. [[3400 BBY]]
**Two Sith, the [[Dreamer]] and the [[Monster-Slayer]], [[Duel between The Dreamer and The Monster-Slayer|duel]], ending in the death of both.<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

*[[3350 BBY]]
**The [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] is founded as an independent territory.<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[3300 BBY]]
**The environmental chaos on Sraato caused by the meteor storm finally comes to an end.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
*c. [[3200 BBY]]
**The [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] is rediscovered by probe droids exploring the Perlemian Trade Route's spurs, but is cataloged as uninhabitable.<ref name="Geonosis" />
*c. [[3100 BBY]]
**The Hapan [[Queen Mother]] seals the borders of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], beginning thousands of years of isolation.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3060 BBY]]
**[[Varner Hilts]] is born on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].
*[[3053 BBY]]
**[[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]] is discovered by two independent prospectors [[Vandel]] and [[Helm]].<ref name="Vandelhelm">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw200403041vandelhelm|series=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys|text=Part 1: File Vandelhelm-LC/hsnn}}</ref>
*[[3025 BBY]]
**Caretaker [[Varner Hilts]] coins the term "[[Time of the Rot|The Time of the Rot]]" to describe the period of upheaval and civil unrest on Kesh.<ref name="Pantheon" />
*[[3017 BBY]]
**The [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]], the last of such conflicts, comes to an end.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[3000 BBY]]
**The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] undergoes a [[War of the Gungan tribes|civil war]]<ref name="Atlas" /> that leads to their unification under [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] and the founding of the city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
**The [[Paecian Empire]] colonizes the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]],<ref name="Atlas" /> using it as a penal colony. {{Circa}}<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
**The [[Hapan Royal Guard]], or Chume'doro, first begins service as the Queen Mother's protectors.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
**The planet [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] is colonized.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
**[[Varner Hilts]] becomes [[Grand Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
*c. [[2992 BBY]]<ref name="Courtship" />
**The Paecian Empire collapses.<ref name="Courtship" />
*c. [[2989 BBY]]
**The [[Talecalle volcano chain]] erupts before entering a dormant stage that lasts for three thousand years.<ref name="Files Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
*[[2975 BBY]]
**High Lord [[Edell Vrai]]'s [[Mission to Alanciar|mission]] to the continent of Alanciar ends in failure as the Alanciari shoot down the Tribe's airships.<ref name="Pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>
**High Lord [[Korsin Bentado]] attempts to [[Invasion of Alanciar|invade]] Alanciar, but is also repelled by the Alanciari. He and the remainder of his forces then assassinate the entire Alanciari War Cabinet.<ref name="Pandemonium" />
**Edell Vrai and Alanciari allies halt Bentado's attempt to create a "Second Tribe" on Alanciar, and the Lost Tribe annexes Alanciar with minimal hostilities.<ref name="Pandemonium" />
*[[2974 BBY]]
**After the Tribe discovers the polar continent of [[Eshkrene]], a chain of events result in the release of the ancient Sith Lord [[Remulus Dreypa]] from his imprisonment.<ref name="Spiral">''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral]]''</ref>
**Baron Dreypa leads a revolt against the Lost Tribe and unearths his [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|Leviathans]] from [[Sessal Spire]], and then leads an invasion of the city of [[Tahv]].<ref name="Spiral" />
**Dreypa's invasion ends with the Sith Lord's death, and the Tribe reasserts control of Kesh.<ref name="Spiral" />
*2500s BBY<ref name="Warfare" />
**The "battleship era" comes to an end thanks to economic strains, and tacticians largely start to prefer fleets of smaller cruisers.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[2500 BBY/Legends|2519 BBY]]
**The main hall of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] is constructed.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
*c. [[2500 BBY/Legends|2500 BBY]]
**Prospectors discover that the core of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] has fused [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] into [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]], sparking a mining rush that dies out less than a century later.<ref name="Geonosis" />
*[[2367 BBY]]
**The first [[Priole Danna Festival]] is held on [[Lamuir IV]].<ref name="Priole">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_1.html|Priole Danna Festival Still a Go}}</ref>
*[[2320 BBY/Legends|2320 BBY]]
**The planet [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] is settled as an agricultural outpost.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[2219 BBY]]
**The [[Saffa (species)|Saffa]] species begins a period that sees them create [[Saffa paintings]].<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
*[[2203 BBY]]
**The Shapani Bypass was established, being used as a shortcut for [[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]] transport between [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Player Tapani" />
*[[2200 BBY/Legends|2200 BBY]]
**The [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] claims the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] along with a number of other worlds in the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]], but Ruusan's mineral deposits prove disappointing.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[2132 BBY]]
**The [[Breath Stealing]] occurs on [[Alphoresis]], an event that claims the lives of every child under the age of eight.<ref name="Gazetteer">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref>
*c.2,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]
**[[Durge/Legends|Durge]] is born.<ref name="TOSWFF 128">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 128|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 128]]</ref>

==[[Draggulch Period]] (2000 BBY-1000 BBY)==
*[[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" />
**The [[Draggulch Period]] begins.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[New Sith Wars]] begins with the [[Fourth Great Schism]]: the Jedi Master [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Phanius]] leaves the Jedi Order with fifty followers and takes the name Darth Ruin as he founds the [[New Sith]], igniting a thousand years of conflict with the Sith.<ref name="Atlas" />
**A group of families and friends of members of the Jedi Order flee the early battles of the New Sith Wars, settling on the Outer Rim planet of [[Yanibar]] in hopes of establishing a temporary refuge. However, the colonists' relatives and allies are killed during the conflict, causing Yanibar to be forgotten; the colonists develop the [[Zeison Sha]] Force tradition.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**A [[Bimm/Legends|Near-Human]] species immigrates to the planet [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]], where they adopt the culture of the native [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimms]] and are integrated into Bimm culture, also becoming known as Bimms.<ref name="Essential Alien" />
*[[1989 BBY]]
**[[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] is first colonized with the commissioning of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />
*[[1960 BBY]]
**The [[Amulet of Kalara]] is fashioned. {{Circa}}<ref name="Kalara">{{CSWECite|I||Amulet of Kalara}}</ref>
*[[1800 BBY]]
**An [[Bombardment of the Uba system|orbital bombardment]] of the planets in the [[Uba system/Legends|Uba system]], a preemptive strike by the Republic to deter the native [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] from continuing to build banned weapons, ignites superweapon caches that engulf the planets in radioactive firestorms.<ref name="Alien Anthology" /> The native [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] are nearly exterminated by the event,<ref name="Atlas" /> with the only survivors on [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]]; some are relocated to the [[Ubertica system/Legends|Ubertica system]], but the event sparks a deep-seated hatred of the Republic among the Ubese.<ref name="Alien Anthology" />
*c. [[1750 BBY]]
**The [[Dark Underlord]] seizes power and marshals his [[Black Knights]], who raid space stations along the [[Zona Miki route]]. The Republic counter by hiring Mandalorian mercenaries who fight alongside the Jedi in [[Battle of Malrev IV|battle]] at [[Malrev IV]], where the Jedi Master [[Murrtaggh]] struck down the Dark Underlord.<ref name="Evil Never Dies" />
*[[1582 BBY]]
**A military coup in the Tapani Empire brings down the [[Kappela Dynasty]], and the region forms the [[Tapani Federation]]. The coup marks the transition from the Dynastic Era to the [[Federal Era]] of the region.<ref name="Player Tapani" />
*[[1569 BBY]]
**The end of the height of Saffa paintings. {{Circa}}<ref name="Heir" />
*[[1500 BBY]]
**The Republic drafts a large number of soldiers and halts the Sith offensive at [[King's Galquek]], [[Corphelion]], and [[Hiit]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The ''[[Sayings]]'', a collection of instructions about political strategy and conquest by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Uueg Tching]] of [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], are printed in a small run by the current Atrisian Emperor. The printing is a ploy by the Emperor to display his power to the Atrisian nobility, who are given the printed ''Sayings''. {{Circa}}<ref name="Files Antilles" />
*[[1486 BBY]]
**The Tapani Federation sends its first representatives to the Galactic Senate, and the Tapani sector is established as a Republic sector.<ref name="Player Tapani" />
*[[1466 BBY]]
**The [[Battle of Mizra]] occurs, ending with a Jedi defeat.<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[1419 BBY]]
**[[Dreypa's Oubliette]] is rediscovered on [[Jebble]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Dark Times 11">[[Dark Times 11|''Dark Times'' 11]]</ref>
*c. [[1300 BBY/Legends|1300 BBY]]
**Republic scouts discover the planet [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] in the ore-rich [[Lan system]].<ref name="Lan Barell">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref>
*[[1250 BBY]]
**The Sith Lord [[Belia Darzu]] comes to power, beginning a period known as the [[Sictis Wars]] as she unleashes her [[technobeast]]s.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[1230 BBY]]
**The [[Sictis Wars]] end with Darzu's [[Assassination of Belia Darzu|death]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="New Droids" />
*[[1196 BBY]]
**[[Hathrox III]] undergoes a biochemical [[Hathrox III civil war|civil war]] that wipes out the entire population.<ref name="Hathrox">{{CSWECite|II|25|Hathrox III}}</ref>
*[[1154 BBY]]
**The [[Begali Uprising]] begins, which sees the planets [[Begali]] and [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] revolt against the rule of the [[Echani Command]] over the [[Six Sisters]]. Begali rejoins the Echani Command less than a century later.<ref name="Author's Cut 2" />
*[[1100 BBY/Legends|1100 BBY]]
**The [[Republic Dark Age]] begins.<ref name="NEC" />
*c. [[1094 BBY]]

Appalled, Awaud leads a movement known as the Return in an effort to convince Mandalorians to defend their territory.<ref name="Warfare" />

**Lord [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]] decides to take the offensive against the Sith, and gathers [[Jedi Lord]]s and bands of Knights behind his banner. The Grand Council of the Order ultimately declares all of the Jedi baronies united as the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] under Hoth, who bears the title of [[Seneschal/Legends|Seneschal]].<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] is born on [[Somov Rit]].

**Chancellor [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] presides over the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], which dismantles the Republic's central authority, abolishing the Republic's standing armed forces and reorganizing its millions of [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] into 1,024 regional sectors, each represented by a single [[Senator/Legends|Senator]].<ref name="Atlas" />

[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] (25: The Discreet Charm of the Meritocracy) states that Padmé Amidala "has only just turned thirteen" and that Gravid's reign "elapsed some five [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] earlier" which would place the quote regarding Gravid's death in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Thus, this article assumes that Gravid [[Death/Legends|died]] around [[533 BBY]].</ref>

The book states on page 3 that "the information gathered here represents the state of the planets two years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]." The Battle of Endor occurred in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, simple math places this event in 296 BBY.</ref>
