*<span id="SW1"></span>[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]
**[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], former [[Princess of Theed]], is elected [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
**As a protest to the increased taxation of trade routes, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], under the influence of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockades, and eventually invades]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM" />
**[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] are secretly dispatched by Chancellor Valorum to resolve the conflict peacefully. This fails when Viceroy Gunray orders the Jedi to be killed.<ref name="TPM" />
**Jinn and Kenobi flee to the surface of the planet during the early stages of the invasion and rescue [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], along with her political retinue and personal security force. Due to a communications blackout on Naboo, they decide to travel to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to appeal directly to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] regarding the Trade Federation's invasion.<ref name="TPM" />
**Queen Amidala, the Jedi, and their allies escape Naboo onboard the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Naboo Royal Starship]]. However, the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] are both damaged. Though the shields are restored by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the damage to the hyperdrive forces them to land on the remote world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for repairs.<ref name="TPM" />
**[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave boy]], is discovered by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Qui-Gon wins Anakin's freedom by betting against Anakin's owner [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace, which Anakin himself participates in. The monetary winnings from the race are subsequently used to repair the Naboo Royal Starship's hyperdrive.<ref name="TPM" />
**While on Tatooine, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] is [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|encountered]] by Qui-Gon Jinn. This eventually leads to the Jedi Order learning that the Sith have returned.<ref name="TPM" />
**The Queen arrives on Coruscant and addresses the Galactic Senate about the Trade Federation's occupation of Naboo. Due to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] apparent inability to take direct action to help Naboo, Amidala calls for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum's leadership. Valorum is promptly impeached the following day.<ref name="TPM" />
**[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] returns to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and ends a period of disdain between the two predominant species on the planet: [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. The Gungans engage the droid army while the Queen and her security force capture the leaders of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. In the battle, Qui-Gon Jinn is killed by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who, in turn, is bisected by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], but survives. [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] is killed when the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] is destroyed by Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="TPM" />
**[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] is killed by his apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who then becomes the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
**Following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] is elected Supreme Chancellor of the Republic, replacing [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="TPM" />
**The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] grants [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and allow him to take on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="TPM" />
**[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] leaves the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and disappears, secretly joining [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**The creation of a secret [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army begins on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], under the order placed by Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] a bounty hunter whose DNA is the specimen for replication, requests an unaltered clone be made for him; he names him [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>
**Count Dooku murders Sifo-Dyas and becomes [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], the second Sith apprentice of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>
**The [[Red Guard]] is formed.
**[[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] retires as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and is succeeded by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]].<ref name="Antilles Databank">{{DB|character|bailantilles|Antilles, Bail}}</ref>

*[[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]
**The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] is officially formed by [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. Shortly afterwards, thousands of planets leave the Republic and align themselves with the CIS, thus beginning the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].
**[[Granta Omega]] plots two assassination attempts on [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and though they are averted by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], 21 Senators are killed.

**[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] reaches the end of his second term as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]; the passage of the [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|Emergency Powers Act]] allows him to stay in office until the Separatist Crisis is dealt with.
**[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], after serving two terms as Queen, is appointed by her successor [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] to be [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]].
**In response to the growing threat of the CIS, the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], a bill proposing the reformation of the Republc's [[Republic Military/Legends|armed forces]], is brought to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] floor for the first time.

*<span id="SW2"></span>[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]
**[[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] is born. {{Circa}}
**The [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|Ansion Border Dispute]] takes place. The [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] attempts to convince [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, the dispute is settled by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] delegation consisting of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]].
**Two years after it was first introduced, the Senate convenes to vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. However, the vote on the bill is delayed after [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|two failed assassination attempts]] on Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].
**For her own protection, Senator Amidala is sent back to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] along with Anakin Skywalker. Meanwhile, Obi-Wan Kenobi begins investigating the assassination attempts, with his search eventually leading him to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], where he discovers [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]' [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] for the first time; he subsequently comes to the conclusion that the army's [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], carried out the assassination attempts on Senator Amidala.
**Anakin returns to his homeworld of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and meets his stepfather [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], Cliegg's son [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and Owen's girlfriend [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru]] for the first time. He also encounters his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] for the first time since he departed from Tatooine.
**Anakin learns from Cliegg that his mother, Shmi, had been kidnapped by a band of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] a month previously. Anakin desperately goes looking for her and eventually finds her in a small Tusken encampment. Unfortunately, Shmi's wounds are too severe, and only moments after Anakin rescues her, she dies in her son's arms. Anakin is overcome with grief and anger and, in a blind fury, massacres the entire encampment.
**Kenobi follows Fett from Kamino to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where he learns that the leaders of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], as well as Geonosian Archduke [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], have pledged their droid armies to Count Dooku, and that [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] had ordered the assassination attempts on Senator Amidala as revenge for the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Shortly afterwards, he is captured by Dooku.
**After receiving a message from Kenobi revealing that the CIS was marshaling a droid army, the Senate convenes in a special session where Chancellor Palpatine is granted emergency powers, allowing him to pass the Military Creation Act without approval from the Senate. Palpatine uses his newfound powers to formally create the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
**Anakin and Padmé, being accompanied by C-3PO and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], travel to Geonosis in a bid to rescue Obi-Wan, but ultimately end up being captured themselves. The three are slated to be executed in Geonosis' [[Petranaki arena|Pentranaki Arena]].
**The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] begins when [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] leads a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]] of Jedi to rescue Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé. In the ensuing clash between the Jedi and the Separatists' battle droids, many Jedi, including High Council member [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]], are killed, and Jango Fett is killed as well. When it appears that the Jedi are going to lose the battle, Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrives with reinforcements: the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from Kamino. With the timely arrival of the clones, the battle is won by the Republic, but Dooku escapes.
**The battle on Geonosis marks the official beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
**[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] marry in secret on Naboo.<ref name="AotC" />
**[[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]] is elected [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo.
**[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] is elevated to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], replacing Coleman Trebor.

==The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] (21.5 BBY-19.5 BBY)==
*[[21 BBY/Legends|21.5 BBY]]
**The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] is formed.
**[[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] secedes from the Republic.
**The Republic begins work on the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]], employing [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to construct the machines. However, the finished vehicles are stolen by [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]], a Separatist general who uses them to [[Assault on Sarapin|take over]] [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]].
**[[Echuu Shen-Jon]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], is dispatched to Sarapin to end the threat of the Decimators. Eventually pursing Tann to [[Krant]], Shen-Jon is successful in destroying the Decimator factories and killing Tann.
**The [[Dark Reaper crisis]] occurs.
**Count Dooku takes on former [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] as his personal assassin and informal apprentice.
**Republic forces under command of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] are [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|dispatched]] to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilist]] to disable the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] droid factories. They also encounter the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], who commands the droid forces. Kenobi eventually defeats Durge in single combat.
**Asajj Ventress lures [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where the two engage in a [[Duel on Yavin 4|grueling lightsaber duel]]. Skywalker seemingly emerges victorious after casting Ventress into a ravine, but she would survive.
**The Battle of Muunilist ends with a Republic victory, as well as the capture of Banking Clan [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] and [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]].
**The Republic suffers a crushing defeat at the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]], with the Jedi [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], and [[K'Kruhk]] being the only survivors. It is during this battle that the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] cyborg [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] is revealed as the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]].
**Anakin Skywalker undergoes his [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighting ceremony]] and becomes a full [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].

*[[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]
**[[Lumiya]] is born on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. {{Circa}}
**The [[Reflex Amendment/Legends|Reflex Amendment]] is passed.
**[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] is born on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
**[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] is born on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
**The [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]], or COMPOR, is formed.
**[[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] disappears.
**[[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] marries [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun]].
**The [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] is fought.
**[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] is apprenticed to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
**[[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] conspires to turn [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] against the Galactic Republic by implicating the Jedi in the kidnapping of his son [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]].
**Anakin and Ahsoka rescue Rotta and bring him back to his father. It is also revealed by Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] that Jabba's uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], orchestrated the plot and conspired with Dooku as a means of taking over the Hutt clans. As thanks for returning his son to him, Jabba allows the Republic safe travel through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].
**[[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] is [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded and subjugated]] by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].
**[[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] is killed.

*[[20 BBY/Legends|20.5 BBY]]
**[[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] is liberated.
**[[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] defects to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
**The [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]] is formed by Duchess [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].
**The [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], under their leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], revolt against Kryze in order to destabilize her [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] government.
**Senator [[Viento]] is assassinated.

*[[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]
**Exile of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mith'raw'nuruodo]].
**[[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] becomes [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] of the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]].
**[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] returns.
**The [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] is formed by [[Maul]].
**[[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] is [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|taken over]] by the Shadow Collective.
**[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] is killed by [[Savage Opress]]. Her seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] is filled by her cousin, [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]].
**[[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]] dies.
**[[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] is captured by the Republic.

*[[19 BBY/Legends|19.5 BBY]]
**[[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] falls to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombs]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] is framed for this crime and is expelled from the Jedi Order. Offee later confesses and Tano is pardoned, but she does not return to the Order, parting on her own way.<ref name="Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>
**Beginning of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].
**The [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] is passed.<ref name="RotS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>
**Making use of a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|CIS fleet]] launches an [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and captures [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] lead the Republic's defense of Coruscant from space and navigate to the CIS flagship to rescue the Chancellor.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>
**Kenobi and Skywalker board the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] and rescue the Chancellor. They also encounter [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who is killed by Skywalker. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] escapes, and becomes the ''de facto'' leader of the CIS.
**[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] learns that she is pregnant with her and Anakin's child.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
**The [[Security Act amendment|Security Act]] is passed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], giving the Supreme Chancellor ultimate authority over the Jedi Order and the Republic Armed Forces.<ref name="ROTS" />
**Palpatine appoints Anakin Skywalker as his personal representative on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], making him the youngest ever member of the High Council at that point. The Council does not grant him the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], however.<ref name="ROTS" />
**[[Clone Intelligence/Legends|Clone Intelligence]] learns that General Grievous and the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] are hiding out on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="ROTS" />
**Grievous sends the members of the Separatist Council to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] while he remains on Utapau.<ref name="ROTS" />
**The [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] is fought, and Grievous is killed by Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="ROTS" />
**The Jedi Council learns that Chancellor Palpatine is, in fact, Darth Sidious, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], along with fellow Council members [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], attempt to [[Showdown on Coruscant|relieve Palpatine of his duties]], but Palpatine resists and engages the four Jedi in a lightsaber duel, successfully slaying all of them but Windu.<ref name="ROTS" />
**Anakin intervenes as Windu attempts to strike Palpatine down, preventing him from doing so by slicing off Windu's hand. This allows Palpatine to finish Windu off by throwing him out of his window.<ref name="ROTS" />
**Anakin falls to the dark side of the Force and swears himself as Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. Palpatine rechristens him "Darth Vader" and instructs him to lead an [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|assault]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="ROTS" />
**Palpatine issues [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]: the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] across the galaxy turn on their Jedi commanders and kill them, effectively wiping out most of the Jedi Order. This marks the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="ROTS" />
**The [[Declaration of a New Order]]: Palpatine formally reorganizes the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="ROTS" />
**Darth Vader travels to Mustafar, where he wipes out the entire Separatist Council, officially ending the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ROTS" />
**Obi-Wan tracks down Vader and [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duels him]]. The duel ends when Obi-Wan severs both of Vader's legs and left arm and leaves him for dead. Despite suffering horrendous burns that leaves him physically and emotionally scarred and disfigured, Vader survives, and is retrieved by Palpatine and brought back to Coruscant. Despite his survival, Vader's injuries are so severe that he is forced to wear a respirator and a [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|full body suit]] to stay alive.<ref name="ROTS" />
**Padmé is taken to a medical facility on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], where she gives birth to twins, whom she names [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]]. She dies shortly afterwards, having lost the will to live after Anakin's fall to the dark side.<ref name="ROTS" />
**In order to protect them from the Empire, Luke and Leia are split up; Luke is placed in the care of Anakin's stepbrother and stepsister-in law, [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]], while Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and his wife, [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha]], agree to raise Leia as their daughter.<ref name="ROTS" />
**Both Obi-Wan and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] enter into exile, with Obi-Wan going to Tatooine and Yoda to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="ROTS" />
**[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] are entrusted to Captain [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]. C-3PO's memory is subsequently [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiped]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==[[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] (19 BBY-0 BBY)==
*[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]
**The newly-formed Galactic Empire begins the process of [[Imperialization/Legends|imperializing]] the galaxy.<ref name="ROTS" />
**Construction begins on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ROTS" />
**The ''[[Book of Sith]]'' is published.<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
**[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and Bail Organa along with other senators loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], discuss in secret plans for a Rebellion. This eventually leads to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RotS novel" />
**The [[Cleansing of New Plympto]] takes place.
**[[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] is [[Caamas Firestorm|devastated]] by the Empire.
**[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] is born on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].
**[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], better known by his [[Core name/Legends|core name]] Thrawn, is recruited into the newly-formed [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] by Emperor Palpatine.
**[[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]] is born on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
**[[Korto Vos]], the son of [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and his wife, [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]], is born in secret on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
**[[Rivoche Tarkin]] is born on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. {{Circa}}

*[[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]
**[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] begins work on the ''[[Dark Side Compendium]]''.
**The [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]] occurs.
**[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] is born on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
**[[Stavin Thaal]] is born on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].
**[[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] enlists in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].
**[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plett]] turns his fortress in [[Plett's Well|Plawal]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] into a sanctuary for fugitives from the Emperor's Jedi purge.
**Emperor Palpatine constructs the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''.
**[[Callista Ming]] transfers her spirit to the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''{{'s}} computer system.
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] meets his cousin [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]], who sells him back to [[Garris Shrike]].
**[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] finds [[Ferus Olin]], (a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] apprentice of [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]]), on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] and foils an Imperial plot to mass murder the residents of Bellassa's capital city, [[Ussa]].
**Ferus Olin finds [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Garen Muln]] in the Crystal Caves of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].
**Obi-Wan Kenobi stops [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Sancor]] from finding information about [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] death on the asteroid [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].
**Ferus Olin and [[Trever Flume]] find Jedi Master [[Fy-Tor-Ana]], now going by the name of "Solace", in the underlevels of Coruscant, with the help of [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].
**Ferus Olin is captured by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the Jedi Temple, and then interrogated by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]].
**Ferus Olin, with the help of Queen [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] and [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], defeats Malorum and temporarily rids [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] of its Imperial presence.
**In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|Battle of Naboo]], in which [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] is assassinated, the Empire installs [[Kylantha]] as the new Queen of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|her people]].
**[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tracks down Jedi survivor [[Kento Marek]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and subsequently kills him. Vader discovers Kento's very young son, [[Galen Marek|Galen]], and decides to take the boy as his secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].
**Darth Vader begins searching for the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] of [[Darth Ramage]].

*[[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]
**The [[Reconquest of the Rim]] comes to an end, with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] fully brought under the rule of the Galactic Empire.
**[[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]] is born on [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]].
**[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] is born.
**[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] defeats all of the [[Sa Cuis]] clones and defeats the rebellious [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sheyvan]] in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel.
**[[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] experienced an internal coup when [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] of the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]] conquered his rivals. Under its new leadership, the planet would become a free trading port and an emerging economic power.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], a Jedi survivor of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], becomes a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and encounters [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during a raid. After losing a [[Duel on Tatooine (Imperial Period)|lightsaber duel]] to Kenobi, Hett is regarded as a disgrace among the Tusken Raiders and is eventually forced to leave Tatooine and become a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
**Hett encounters the spirit of the ancient Sith Lord [[XoXaan]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and agrees to learn the ways of the Sith, spending decades training in the ancient Sith tombs on Korriban.

*[[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]]
**[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] marries [[Sintas Vel]].
**[[Skee (Rodian)|Skee]] and his family flee to an unknown jungle planet during the [[Rodian Clan Wars]].
**[[Havet Storm]] is born.

*[[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]
**[[Ailyn Vel]], daughter of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Sintas Vel]], is born.
**The [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] are enslaved by the Galactic Empire.
**The [[Justice Action Network]] is founded.
**The [[Rego Mineral Company]] contacts [[Altor 14]].
**The [[Fromm Tower Droid]] is created.
**[[Peace City]] is founded on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] by [[Aruk Besadii Aora]] and [[Zavval]].

*[[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]]
**[[Cray Mingla]] is born.
**[[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] joins the Galactic Empire.
**[[Syal Antilles Fel|Syal Antilles]] runs away from home and changes her name to Wynssa Starflare.
**The [[Sartran Corporation/Legends|Sartran Corporation]] is disbanded by the Galactic Empire.

*[[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]]
**The [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]] is re-discovered.
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] wins the [[Junior Championship Division|junior]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] championship of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

*[[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]]
**[[Teneniel Djo]] is born on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. {{Circa}}
**A joint Imperial/Centrality invasion force conquers the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]] after a brutal conflict.
**The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] is [[Kamino uprising|dispatched]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to eliminate an [[Anti-trooper|army]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] created in opposition of the Galactic Empire.
**Han Solo wins the junior swoop racing championship for a second time.

*[[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]]
**[[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] is discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; slaving and mining operations are quickly established.
**[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] is blackmailed from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and enlists in the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].
**[[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] is rediscovered by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jerg]].
**Han Solo wins the swoop racing championship for the entire [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].

*[[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]]
**The [[Second Great Droid Revolution]] occurs.
**[[Gavin Darklighter]] is born on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] escapes from [[Liberator (Liberator-class)|''Trader's Luck'']] and begins life on his own, apart from [[Garris Shrike]]'s band of orphans.
**Beginning of the [[Reslian Purge]].

*[[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]]
**Following the fallout from the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]], the Empire begins to employ clones from different templates and non-clones into the Stormtrooper ranks.
**[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] enters the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].
**A groundquake crumbles [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] civilization, converting those that survived into spacefaring nomads.
**The [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290 light freighter]] that would become ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' is manufactured.
**[[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] purchases the patents and production rights to the [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-interceptor]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 Nimbus V-wing]] from [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]].
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] contracts a case of [[Dust fever|Tatooine dust fever]].
**An entire village of settlers on [[Coveway]] is killed by the new Imperial garrison's commander.

*[[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]]
**The [[Contruum rebellion|Contruum Rebellion]] begins.
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] earns the nickname "Slick" from [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Alexsandr Badure|Badure]] when he safely lands a malfunctioning [[U-33 orbital loadlifter]].
**[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] discovers a method of transferring his consciousness into a new body in a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] retrieved from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ashka Boda]].
**The [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] storehouse on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] completes construction. Its architects, the [[Garrbo V'Droz|V'Droz brothers]], are killed to keep it a secret.
**[[Venthan Chassu/Legends|Venthan Chassu's]] [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] nudes are displayed in the [[Museum of Fine Art|Coronet City Museum of Fine Art]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
**[[Huegu Eib]] sells [[Gryseium Incorporated]] to [[Rigis Corazon]].
**The [[Mecetti Province]]'s government nationalizes its key industries.

*[[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]]
**[[Hargeeva]] is [[Annexation of Hargeeva|annexed]] by the Galactic Empire.
**On [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], two hundred thousand [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] perish in a controlled Imperial bombardment of a city ruled by [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] father to quarantine the spread of a biological weapon.
**[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] is assigned the 6th Squadron of the [[37th Imperial Fighter Wing]].
**[[Fliry Vorru]] is sent to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] after being framed by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].
**[[Ken]] is born on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Shortly after his birth he is spirited away to the [[Lost City of the Jedi]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
**[[Kyp Durron]] is born on [[Deyer]].

*[[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]]
**The [[Reslian Purge]] ends.
**[[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] becomes Senator of Naboo at age 20.
**The [[Garosian civil war|civil war]] on [[Garos IV]] comes to an end.
**[[Loka Hask]] is expelled from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] graduates from the same institution.
**[[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] seizes control of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].
**[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] visits [[Trammis III/Legends|Trammis III]].
**Captain [[Hoffner]] and [[Talon Karrde]] discovers the [[Katana fleet|Katana Fleet]].

*[[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]]
**Han Solo, now in a military academy, saves [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], now a slave, and is subsequently drummed out of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Chewbacca pledges a life-debt to Han Solo and remains his partner for the next three decades.
**[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] is assigned to be [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] personal valet.
**[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] wins the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in a game of sabacc.
**[[Kyle Katarn]] enters the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].
**All life on the planet [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] is eradicated by [[Rokur Gepta]], the last of the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]].

*[[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]
**[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] discovers the [[Mindharp of Sharu/Legends|Mindharp]]; its accidental activation causes massive changes in the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]].
**[[Jorj Car'das]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]] is commandeered by a [[Bpfassh]]i [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. The vessel crashes on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], where [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] kills the Dark Jedi and heals Car'das.
**The [[Service Special]] blaster pistol is developed.
**[[Slyder]] moves onboard the ''[[Star of Empire]]''.
**[[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] attempts to slaughter [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo's]] family, forcing them to flee to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
**On [[Zelos II]], an attack on the capital city of [[Kryndyn]] by a horde of nocturnal predators resulted in the death of the planet's leaders. In response, [[General/Legends|general]] [[Galleros Nul]] declared a state of emergency and launched a successful counterattack. However, Nul, who had no intention giving up his power, did not lift the state of emergency.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two 70">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]'' states that this occurred "10 years ago," and that "the information gathered here represents the state of the planets two years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]." The Battle of Endor occurred in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, simple math places this event in 4 BBY.</ref>

*[[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]
**[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] participates in the [[Bombing of Callos]].
**[[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] goes bankrupt.
**[[Imperial Research Station 61]] is built on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].
**[[Canna Omonda]] becomes senator of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], replacing [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].
**[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] saves the [[Oswaft]] people and kills [[Rokur Gepta]].
**[[Tavell Geen]] becomes [[Scrivinir]] of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]].
**The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spy post, [[Ghost Base]], is discovered and captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
**The first recorded encounter with a [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]].
**[[Narg]] is taken over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
**The [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]] is constructed.

*[[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]
**The [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] is created.
**Meant to eventually overthrow [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sends a secret apprentice, [[Galen Marek]] (primarily known by his code name, Starkiller), to hunt down and eradicate the last of the Jedi, including [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] (though he would survive his encounter with Starkiller) and [[Kazdan Paratus]].
**[[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], one of the last surviving members of the Jedi High Council at the time of Order 66, is [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|killed]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] by Galen Marek.
**Marek, under orders from Vader, seeks out the secret enemies of the Empire and convinces them to organize to actively fight the Emperor.
**Marek ultimately turns against both Vader and Palpatine and is killed by Palpatine during a [[Battle on Death Star I|confrontation]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].
**Inspired by the death of Galen Marek, the [[Corellian Treaty]] is signed, giving birth to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
**The [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] begins.
**[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] takes formal control of the [[Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] after killing the offspring of [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]].
**The Rebel Alliance begins [[Operation Skyhook]], a series of campaigns to gain information about the Death Star.
**[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] creates the position of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]].
**Large [[phrikite]] deposits are located on [[Gromas 16]].
**The [[Cult of Varn]] is developed on [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]].
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] wins the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] during a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
**[[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Odumin]] disrupted the [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade.
**[[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] befriends [[Anky Fremp]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
**[[Demetrius Zaarin]] becomes [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] at [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]].
**[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat]] [[Dupas Thomree]] dies.
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] attempt a [[clotheslegging]] scheme in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]].
**[[Lumiya]] enrolls at the [[Coruscani Pilot Institute]].

*[[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#1 BBY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]
**[[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]], son of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], is born on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
**A group of Moffs led by [[Trachta]], [[Anti-Sith conspiracy|plot to overthrow]] Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader. The plot fails and almost all of the conspirators are met with unspeakable deaths.
**Darth Vader attempts to create a stable clone of Galen Marek on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. [[Subject 1138|One clone]] of Marek, known simply as "Starkiller" (like Galen Marek originally was), escapes and rescues General [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. Though reluctant at first, Starkiller joins the Rebel Alliance.
**Thanks to Starkiller's efforts, the Rebel Alliance win one of their first victories against the Empire at the [[Assault on Kamino]]. Darth Vader is captured by the Rebels, but escapes shortly afterwards.

==[[Rebellion era|The Rebellion era]]==
[[File:Era-reb.png|right]]
*[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#0 BBY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]
**The last of the [[Houk–Weequay conflicts]] takes place when the Galactic Empire [[Subjugation of Sriluur|subjugates]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]].<ref name="Geonosis" />
**The [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] is formally disbanded, giving [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] absolute power.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
**The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] finishes construction.<ref name="ANH" />
**[[Despayre]] is [[Destruction of Despayre|destroyed]] by the Death Star in the first official test of the Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].<ref name="ANH" />
**The Rebel Alliance claim what they consider to be their first major victory against the Galactic Empire at the [[Battle of Toprawa]], obtaining a full set of [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the Death Star, which are then transmitted to Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] onboard her personal starship, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].<ref name="ANH" />
**Princess Leia attempts to deliver the Death Star plans to her adoptive father, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], on Alderaan, and also attempts to recruit the exiled Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] into the Alliance, but is captured by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in orbit above [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] before she can.<ref name="ANH" />
**Leia places the plans into the memory systems of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. R2-D2, along with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], escape to the surface of Tatooine, where they are recovered by a band of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and subsequently sold to [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] and his nephew [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="ANH" />
**In an attempt to locate Obi-Wan Kenobi, R2-D2 flees into the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], but is recaptured by Luke and C-3PO. The three are attacked by a band of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], but are subsequently rescued by Kenobi.<ref name="ANH" />
**The [[Desert Sands]] are dispatched to the surface of Tatooine to recover the Death Star plans. Though they are unable to find the plans, they track their last known location to the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], where they kill both Owen and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]]. After this, Luke agrees to help Kenobi return the plans to the Rebel Alliance and announces his intent to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="ANH" />
**Leia Organa is incarcerated onboard the Death Star. When she fails to yield the location of the Rebel Alliance's hidden base, her home planet, Alderaan, is ordered [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. Bail Organa is killed in the planet's destruction.<ref name="ANH" />
**Admiral [[Natasi Daala]] is sent to oversee the [[Maw Installation]] by Grand Moff Tarkin.<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>
**Luke and Obi-Wan acquire the services of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who agree to take them to Alderaan onboard his ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. However, they are captured by the Death Star upon entering the system.<ref name="ANH" />
**Leia Organa is rescued by Luke, Han and Chewbacca. Kenobi confronts Darth Vader for the first time since their [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] nineteen years previously. He allows himself to be struck down by Vader to buy time for Luke and his friends to escape the Death Star onboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', but lives on as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]].<ref name="ANH" />
**Luke, Leia, and the droids arrive at the Rebel Alliance's hidden base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where they subsequently analyze the Death Star plans to discover a potential weakness in the station; they find one in the form of a [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]].<ref name="ANH" />
**The [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] begins when the Death Star arrives in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] with intent to destroy Yavin 4. A force of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing starfighters]] is sent to destroy the Death Star following the successful analysis of the Death Star plans; though many Rebel fighters are destroyed, Luke Skywalker is successful in destroying the station thanks to the timely intervention of Han Solo in the ''Millennium Falcon''. Grand Moff Tarkin, who is onboard the Death Star at the time of the station's destruction, is killed. The Alliance's victory at the Battle of Yavin marks a major turning point in the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="ANH" />
**Following the Battle of Yavin, Luke, Han, and Chewbacca all formally join the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="ANH" />

==After the Battle of Yavin (ABY)==
===Rebellion era (continued) (0 ABY-4 ABY)===
*[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]
**[[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] joins the Rebel Alliance.
**Beginning of the [[Krantian Civil War]].
**[[Lumiya]] infiltrates the Rebel Alliance.
**The [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] is launched under the command of Captain [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]]. It is dispatched to destroy the Rebel base on Yavin. However, a miscalculation from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff|Griff]] allows the Rebels to escape.
**The [[Bounty Hunter Wars]] begin with the collapse of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. The guild is split into two separate groups, the [[True Guild]] and the [[Guild Reform Committee]].
**Construction begins on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].
**[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] defects to the Rebel Alliance.
**[[Sarkli]] defects to the Empire.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#0 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]
**Imperial forces seize [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].
**The [[Codex of Tython]] is discovered on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and a small Alliance fleet are hired by an unknown party to assault an Imperial space station to rescue an unidentified imprisoned spacer. They manage to escape aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].
**[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] defects from the Empire to the Alliance.
**[[Zef Ando]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] squatter, claims the abandoned [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] as his own.
**[[Jaden Korr]] is born. {{Circa}}
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#1 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]
**[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] becomes an officer in the [[Corellian Security Force]].
**An Imperial force led by Darth Vader catches up to some of the Rebels on Ord Mantell. It is here that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] learns the name of the Rebel who destroyed the Death Star, Luke Skywalker, but withholds this information from Darth Vader until the time is right. While on Ord Mantell, [[Skorr/Legends|Skorr]], a bounty hunter working for Jabba the Hutt, nearly captures Han Solo.
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] discover the [[Kaiburr crystal]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#2 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]
**[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] is formed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
**[[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] is constructed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to serve as the Rebel Alliance's primary command center.

*[[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]
**The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] occurs when the Empire discovers [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], successfully destroying the base.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
**Admiral [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] is killed by Darth Vader for incompetence and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] assumes command of Vader's fleet.<ref name="ESB" />
**Luke Skywalker discovers Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], and trains under him. When he receives disturbing visions of the future he halts his training but promises to return.<ref name="ESB" />
**[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] contacts [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and reveals [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] parentage to Vader. Vader suggests a plan to capture and convert Luke rather than kill him as originally suggested. Seeing the potential a more powerful apprentice would have, Palpatine agrees.<ref name="ESB" />
**[[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] is [[Occupation of Bespin|subjugated]] by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="ESB" />
**Boba Fett captures Han Solo to take him to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] after Solo is frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] joins the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="ESB" />
**Darth Vader [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duels]] Luke Skywalker in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and reveals that he is Luke's father.<ref name="ESB" />
**After being driven off Hoth, the Alliance establishes [[Haven Base]] on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]].<ref name="SW55">[[Star Wars (1977) 55|''Star Wars'' (1977) 55]]</ref>
**[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] is killed by Darth Vader and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] collapses.<ref name="SotE Novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#3 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*<span id="SW6"></span>[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]
**[[Lumiya]] is made an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] and travels to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] to learn the ways of the Sith.
**Han Solo is rescued from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and Jabba is killed by Leia Organa. Boba Fett manages to escape the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]], killing it.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
**[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] dies. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] learns that [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] is his long-lost twin sister and eventually reveals this information to her.<ref name="RotJ" />
**The [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] begins. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] surrenders to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] successfully destroys the shield generator with the help of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. Luke duels with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]]. Darth Vader/Anakin Skywalker is redeemed to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] by the efforts of Luke Skywalker. Anakin Skywalker kills Palpatine, saving his son's life, and dies on the light side. The prophecy of the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] is fulfilled<ref name="RotJ" /> as he brings balance to the Force.
**Lando Calrissian, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] destroy the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], bringing about the defining turning point in the Galactic Civil War. No longer under the sway of its dark Sith rulers, the Empire begins to tear itself apart through warlordism. Admiral Piett dies when the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] crashes into the Death Star.<ref name="RotJ" />
**A celebration across the galaxy begins at the fall of the Empire and the death of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Still on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Luke catches a glimpse of the ghosts of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and his father, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] off away from the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] party.<ref name="RotJ" />
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#4 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]
**A small [[Bakura task force|Rebel task force]] responds to a distress call at Bakura. Converting into the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], the Imperial and Alliance forces sign the [[Bakura Truce|''Truce at Bakura'']], a ceasefire to work together to repel the invading [[Ssi-ruu]]k.

===[[New Republic era|The New Republic era]] (4 ABY-25 ABY)===
[[File:Era-new.png|right]]
*[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]
**Beginning of the [[Imperial Civil War]].
**The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] is established.
**[[Lowbacca]] is born on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
**[[Danni Quee]] is born on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].
**[[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] emerges from the Sith tombs on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and departs into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
**[[Silya Shessaun/Legends|Silya Shessaun]] dies.
**The [[Nagai–Tof War]] is fought.

*[[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] attains the rank of [[General/Legends|General]]. Six months later, after Imperial forces under the command of [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]] fought to the last man against his army, he retires from the military.
**[[Sate Pestage]] dies.
**[[Ysanne Isard]] engages in a series of political maneuvers to damage the New Republic and seize control of the Empire.
**[[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]]'s imprisonment on [[Kip]] finally ends after Kip is overrun by space pirates.
**[[Trioculus]] takes control of the remnants of the Empire in opposition to Ysanne Isard. He is killed that same year and his position taken over by the [[Rajah Ubooki|imposter posing as Kadann]] who is killed later.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#5 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]
**[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] reforms under [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].
**New Republic forces switch from the guerrilla tactics of the Alliance to a campaign of claiming important Core Worlds as the Empire's grip crumbles.
**[[Zsinj]] begins his [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against the New Republic.
**Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Octavian Grant]] defects to the New Republic.
**End of the [[Krantian Civil War]].
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#6 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]
**The New Republic captures [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the Empire as it continues to deteriorate.
**[[Jagged Fel]] is born on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]].
**[[Ysanne Isard]] leaves an artificial virus called the [[Krytos virus]] that infects all non-Humans, behind on Coruscant to drain the New Republic's already strained resources and create an enmity between Humans and non-Humans. Together these are designed to tear the New Republic apart.
**[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] learns about his Jedi heritage.
**[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the rest of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] leave the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military and begin the [[Bacta War]] against [[Ysanne Isard]].
**[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the former [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] members attack [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] to get bacta for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
**The New Republic receives the needed [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] from [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the former [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to eliminate the plague. Isard fakes her death and disappears.
**Corran Horn and [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]] are married.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#7 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]
**Leia Organa marries Han Solo.
**[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] allies the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] with the New Republic.
**[[Zsinj]] dies during the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]].
**[[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] joins the New Republic.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#8 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*<span id="TC"></span>[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] are born to Leia Organa and Han Solo.
**Beginning of the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn Crisis]]: [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] returns from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and seizes control of the Imperial fleet, managing to recruit Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and the insane Dark Jedi clone [[Joruus C'baoth]] to his cause.<ref name="Heir" /><ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref><ref name="Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
**Thrawn gains custody of a large portion of the lost [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]].
**The [[Smugglers' Alliance]] is founded by [[Talon Karrde]] in order to assist the New Republic against Thrawn's forces.
**The [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]] is fought: Thrawn is assassinated by his bodyguard, [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]]. His death marks the end of the Thrawn Crisis.
**[[Joruus C'baoth]] is killed at [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].
**[[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] joins the New Republic.
**Obi-Wan Kenobi's spirit moves on.<ref name="Heir" />
**The [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] defect to the New Republic when they discover that the Empire has been manipulating them and polluting their world.<ref name="Last Command" />
**[[Ysanne Isard]] returns, and helps Rogue Squadron defeat her clone, who is using a warlord to do her dirty work. Isard is killed by [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] on the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', while [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] kills the clone and warlord.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#9 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]
**Luke Skywalker meets [[Kam Solusar]].
**[[Alema Rar]] is born on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. {{Circa}}
**The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Second Battle of Coruscant|recaptures]] Coruscant, but splinters into factions, and fights with each other. The New Republic is forced to hide at [[Pinnacle Base]].<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>
**[[Operation Shadow Hand]]: the Empire is revitalized as the "[[Star Wars: Dark Empire|Dark Empire]]" under the rule of the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who seduces Luke Skywalker to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and makes him his second-in-command. However, Luke turns against him and kills Palpatine with Leia and destroys his flagship [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']].<ref name="DE" />
**The New Republic wins the [[Battle of Calamari]].<ref name="DE" />
**[[Anakin Solo]] is born to Leia Organa and Han Solo.<ref name="EE">''[[Star Wars: Empire's End]]''</ref>
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#10 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]
**[[Ponc Gavrisom]] is elected to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].
**Palpatine returns again, but [[Empatojayos Brand|Empatajayos Brand]] destroys his life-force. Brand dies and Palpatine is ultimately dead, freeing the Empire from Sith rule once again.
**[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] destroys ''[[Eclipse II]]'' and the [[Galaxy Gun]], causing the destruction of the Imperial Fleet, and the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], where Palpatine's [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|cloning machines]] were located.<ref name="EE" /><ref name="DE II">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref>
**[[Carnor Jax]] briefly reorganizes Palpatine's Dark Empire into the [[Crimson Empire]], but he is killed on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] before the movement gains any significant traction.
**The New Republic reoccupies [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] establishes the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and his sister Leia becomes [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
**The [[Battle of Ord Cantrell]] is fought. The last [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], [[Xandel Carivus]] is executed by [[Kir Kanos]].<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]''</ref>
**The planet [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]] is rediscovered by Luke Skywalker and Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].
**Admiral [[Natasi Daala]] and her fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] emerge from [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] after 11 years in isolation.
**[[Kyp Durron]], under the influence of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], uses the [[Sun Crusher]] to destroy [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].
**[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] trains at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on Yavin 4. He rescues his wife from [[Leonia Tavira]], and destroys the [[Invids]] from the inside-out.
**[[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] spirit is destroyed.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#11 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]
**The term "[[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]" is used for the first time referring to the shattered remains of the Empire, now [[Imperial Reunification|unified]] under Gilad Pellaeon. After her defeat in the [[Assault on Yavin 4]], Admiral Daala turns control of the [[United Warlord Fleets]] over to Pellaeon, who forms the Remnant. The [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] is formed to serve as the Remnant's governing body. This marks the end of the [[Imperial Civil War]].
**[[Darksaber (superweapon)|Darksaber]] is constructed.
**[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] is killed.
**The lost [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' is found by former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]], who uses it in a [[Ismaren plot|plot]] to restore the Galactic Empire. This plot is foiled by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Nichos Marr/Legends|Nichos Marr]], and [[Cray Mingla]], who destroy the ''Eye''.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#12 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]
**[[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] resurfaces for the first time in nearly three decades and unleashes the [[Death Seed]] plague to try and conquer the galaxy.
**[[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] becomes the [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].
**[[Tahiri Veila]] is born to [[Cassa Veila|Cassa]] and [[Tryst Veila]].<ref name="The Golden Globe">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe]]''</ref>
**[[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] joins the New Republic as a planetary government.
**[[Valin Horn]] is born on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#13 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]
**Lord [[Hethrir]] captures Han and Leia's children, but is defeated.
**Rise and fall of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]].<ref name="JK:JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
**Following the [[Confrontation on Crseih Station|collapse]] of the [[Empire Reborn]] movement, and [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|destruction]] of Disciples of Ragnos cult, major armed conflict between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant drops off, turning into almost a cold war.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#14 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[15 ABY/Legends|15 ABY]]
**[[Tahiri Veila]] is orphaned.
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] confronts [[Brakiss]] for his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] leanings. Brakiss flees [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
**[[Ailyn Vel]] concludes that her father, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], is dead.
**[[Sliven]] is injured badly during a battle between his tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
**Lord [[Cronal]] is killed for the final time on [[Andooweel/Legends|Andooweel]]. {{Circa}}
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#15 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]
**[[Jysella Horn]] is born. {{Circa}}
**The [[Black Fleet Crisis]].
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#16 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]
**The [[Almanian Uprising]].
**[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] marries [[Winter Celchu|Winter]].
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#17 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]
**The [[Corellian Crisis|Corellian Insurrection]].
**[[Kam Solusar]] marries [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]].
**Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] resurfaces to launch a major offensive against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the last gasp of the once-powerful Empire. NR forces under Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] defeat Pellaeon in the [[Battle of Anx Minor]]. The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] is reduced to a mere eight backwater [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], now posing no threat whatsoever to the New Republic and/or the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] at large.
**[[Ponc Gavrisom]] is elected [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the New Republic, succeeding Leia Organa Solo.
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#18 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]
**[[Viqi Shesh]] is elected to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]], representing [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].
**The [[Caamas Document Crisis]].
**The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the last fragment of the Empire sign the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]], ending the 21-year-long [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Vision">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
**See [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War#19 ABY|''battles & missions in the Galactic Civil War for this year'']]

*[[20 ABY/Legends|20 ABY]]
**Luke Skywalker marries [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].

*[[21 ABY/Legends|21 ABY]]
**[[GemDiver Station]] completes construction.
**Leia Organa Solo is reinstated as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the New Republic.

*[[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]
**[[Danni Quee]] joins the [[Extragalactic Society]].
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] join the [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
**Their younger brother [[Anakin Solo]] joins the [[Junior Jedi Academy|Junior Jedi Class]] of the Academy months later and befriends a young Human girl named [[Tahiri Veila]]. The two young trainees have several adventures, including discovering the [[Golden Globe]] and the ancient Jedi Master [[Ikrit]] and accompanying their [[Melodie]] friend [[Lyric]] to her homeworld of [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]] to undergo an [[Changing Ceremony|important ceremony]]. Anakin later returns to Coruscant where he attended school, developed his piloting skills, and studied under the careful tutelage of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].
**Luke and Mara Jade Skywalker travel to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] where they join a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]/[[Empire of the Hand]] mission to locate the remains of the ill-fated [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]/Jedi expedition ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. They discover it in an inaccessible region known as the [[Redoubt]] and also learn that the survivors of the Outbound Flight have founded a colony within the wreckage. This combined team also defeats a [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] attack.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
**[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] memoir, ''[[How to Succeed in Everything]]'', is published.

*[[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]]
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] fight against the [[Second Imperium]] which attempts to disrupt the peace between the New Republic and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], as it has become known, and restart the Galactic Civil War.
**Following the [[Third Battle of Yavin|defeat of the Shadow Academy]], the Jedi Academy is rebuilt. [[Anakin Solo]] also came to aid in the reconstruction efforts.
**[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] resigns her post as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]] replaces her.
**[[Sien Sovv]] becomes [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]].
**[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] retires from bounty hunting and claims the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]].
**The [[Diversity Alliance]], an extremist anti-[[Human/Legends|Human]] organization, is formed.

*[[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]
**The [[Diversity Alliance]] is defeated by the Solo twins.
**An attempt by [[Czethros]] to return [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] to its former glory is thwarted by the Solo twins and their Jedi companions.
**[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] dies.<ref name="TNJO:SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>
**[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] establishes a mining operation in the [[Dubrillion system/Legends|Dubrillion system]].
**The [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] is found at [[Bast Castle]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] finds the lost ''[[Book of Sith]]'' in the ruins of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
**[[Yomin Carr]] infiltrates the [[Extragalactic Society]].
**[[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] dies.<ref name="NEGC" />
**The [[Cooperative Council of Independent Planetary Governments]] is formed.<ref name="The Emperor's Plague">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]''</ref>

===[[New Jedi Order era|The New Jedi Order era]] (25 ABY-37 ABY)===
[[File:Era-njo.png|right]]
*[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]
**The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invade [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
**[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] dies at [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]].
**The [[Historical Council|New Republic Historical Council]] sets the year of the Battle of Yavin to the year zero, adopting the current date system.
**[[Sris Lehhett]] launches a bloody coup of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], declaring himself [[Scrivinir]].

*[[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]
**[[Ben Skywalker]] is born to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].
**Destruction of [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]], its moon [[Indobok]], and [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]].
**The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] is driven off [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] following their invasion of the world and the destruction of the Jedi Praxeum.
**[[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] is overrun by the Yuuzhan Vong.
**[[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] is conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
**[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] are [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] after the Yuuzhan Vong take total control of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The Hutts are forced to take refuge on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
**[[Duro/Legends|Duro]] becomes the first [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] to be conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong.

*[[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]
**The Yuuzhan Vong conquer Coruscant, renaming it for their dead home planet, [[Yuuzhan'tar]]. The New Republic relocates to [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]].
**[[Anakin Solo]] dies on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].
**Chief of State [[Borsk Fey'lya]] is killed.
**[[Cal Omas]] is elected Chief of State.
**[[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka Chume Ta' Djo]] becomes [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].
**The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] declare a state of [[ar'krai]] for the first time in millennia.
**First [[YVH 1]] droid, [[YVH 1-1A]], is released.
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] is imprisoned by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. While imprisoned he encounters [[Vergere]].
**The [[Voxyn]] are destroyed on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].
**[[Vestara Khai]] is born on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].

*[[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]
**The [[YVH-M]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] are created by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].
**The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] is reorganized into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].
**[[Nas Choka]] is [[Escalation|escalated]] to [[Warmaster]].
**[[Ssi-ruu]]k foiled attempt of a second invasion of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] escapes his imprisonment.

*[[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]
**Dissolution of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]].
**Radical&mdash;and still partially obscure&mdash;changes occur in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] and [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] society in general.
**[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] dies.
**[[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|Coruscant is liberated]] from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
**[[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] forges a peace accord between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the Yuuzhan Vong. The war ends after five years of fighting.
**Jacen Solo begins his search for the Force in an effort to determine if [[Vergere]] is right.

*[[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]]
**A [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|new Jedi Academy]] is constructed on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].
**The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] moves it capital from [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] back to Coruscant.
**The last remaining [[Yuuzhan Vong]] are exiled from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
**The [[One Sith]] are founded on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. {{Circa}}

*[[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]]
**Efforts to rebuild galactic civilization after the Yuuzhan Vong war continue, with many war-torn worlds still under reconstruction.
**The Jedi, struggling to come to terms with a new role in the galaxy and a new philosophy on the Force are called upon to act as police and diplomats by the Galactic Alliance, despite the wishes of Luke Skywalker.
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sees an image of his [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|mother]] for the first time through [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
**The [[Dark Nest Crisis]]: a mysterious alien race called the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] with a leader very strong in the Force, who are ancient enemies of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] return, with some of the younger members of the Jedi interfering, and becoming part of their alien "Hive," physically and mentally joined to each other.
**[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] publishes the ''[[The New Essential Chronology|New Essential Chronology]]''.

*[[36 ABY]]
**The [[Swarm War]] occurs.
**The [[Five Worlds]] is founded.
**[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] witnesses a hologram, kept by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], of his [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|father]] leading the slaughter at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], as well as another one in which Anakin was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force-choking]] his [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|mother]].
**The [[Conclave on Ossus]] convenes: Luke Skywalker is made [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[New Jedi Order]].
**[[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] is born to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Tenel Ka Djo]].
**[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] is called out of retirement to succeed [[Sien Sovv]] as [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]] after Sovv is killed in a vehicle collision.

===[[Legacy era|The Legacy era]] (37 ABY-140 ABY)===
[[File:Era-leg.png|right]]
*[[37 ABY]]
**[[Vestara Khai]] obtained her [[uvak]] in a [[Uvak competition|competition]] at [[Presentation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Imprint">"[[Imprint]]"</ref>
**The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] imposed [[Sector Defense Limits]] on its member worlds.<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[38 ABY]]
**[[Shafr Center Press/Legends|The Shafr Center Press]] published ''[[The Shafr Anthology of Galactic Language, Second Edition]]''.<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
**Major [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations were reestablished on [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan's]] surface by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Since the CSA avoided [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], they were economically and industrially solvent enough to rebuild their old facilities and continue their former operations unhindered.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />

*[[39 ABY]]
