**The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] refused to join the [[Five Worlds]], remaining independent from both them and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="Atlas" />

*[[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and his unofficial apprentice [[Ben Skywalker]] return from a [[Mission to Adumar|dangerous covert mission]] on Adumar.<ref name="LotF: Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>
**The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], in an attempt to silence malcontent among its members, begins a deterrent campaign against [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], leaving the galaxy on the edge of a full-scale war. The [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] is created as a result.<ref name="LotF: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
**[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] resigns as Supreme Commander of the Galactic Alliance Defense Force after the creation of the Galactic Alliance Guard. He eventually returns to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and is reinstated as its leader.<ref name="LotF: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] falls to the dark side and becomes a Sith apprentice to [[Lumiya]].<ref name="LotF: Betrayal" />
**The first civil war since the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] breaks out between the Galactic Alliance on one side, and the [[Confederation]] on the other.<ref name="LotF: Betrayal" />
**[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] is forgiven by [[Clan Fett]] and discovers the existence of a clone that [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|fought]] at [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and lived a further 70 years.<ref name="LotF: Bloodlines" />
**[[Mara Jade Skywalker]] is [[Skirmish on Kavan|killed]] by her nephew [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].<ref name="LotF: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>
**[[Lumiya]] is [[Duel on Terephon|killed]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="LotF: Sacrifice" />
**[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] becomes a full Sith Lord, [[Darth Caedus]].<ref name="LotF: Sacrifice" />
**Luke Skywalker forms the [[Jedi Coalition]]; the war becomes a three-way conflict.<ref name="LotF: Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>
**[[Centerpoint Station]] is destroyed due [[Toval Seyah]]'s [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]].<ref name="LotF: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

*[[41 ABY]]
**Admiral [[Natasi Daala]] returns to fight in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LotF: Revelation" />
**[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] is killed by [[Tahiri Veila]] at the [[Second Battle of Fondor]].<ref name="LotF: Revelation" />
**[[Darth Caedus]] makes [[Tahiri Veila]] his Sith apprentice.<ref name="LotF: Revelation" />
**[[Isolder]] is [[Battle of Uroro Station|killed]] by [[Darth Caedus]].<ref name="LotF: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>
**[[Darth Caedus]] is [[Battle of Uroro Station|killed]] by his sister, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].<ref name="LotF: Invincible" />
**The Second Galactic Civil War ends.<ref name="LotF: Invincible" />
**Tahiri Veila renounces the Sith ways and becomes a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="FotJ: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>
**At the end of the war, [[Natasi Daala]] is named the new [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="LotF: Invincible" />
**[[Jagged Fel]] becomes the new leader of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="LotF: Invincible" />
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] adopt their granddaughter, [[Allana Djo Solo]], future Queen Mother of [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes]].<ref name="LotF: Invincible" />
**[[Ben Skywalker]] is declared a full [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="LotF: Fury" />
**[[Mirta Gev]] marries [[Ghes Orade]].<ref name="LotF: Revelation" />

*[[42 ABY]]
**[[Qwallo Mode]] vanishes during a mission in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="FotJ: Outcast" />

*[[43 ABY]]
**[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] embark on a journey to investigate into the history of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Millennium" />
**[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] is charged with dereliction of duty by Chief of State [[Natasi Daala]]. Luke is exiled from the New Jedi Order and the Galactic Alliance afterwards and [[Kenth Hamner]] becomes acting Jedi Grand Master.<ref name="FotJ: Outcast" />
**The [[Unification Summit]] is held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an effort to reunite the galaxy in the aftermath of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FotJ: Outcast" />
**Luke Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], embark on a quest to learn more about [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the dark side and encounter the [[Mind Walkers]] of [[Sinkhole Station]].<ref name="FotJ: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

*[[44 ABY]]
**Widespread slave uprisings spread throughout the galaxy, inspired by the [[Freedom Flight]] organization.<ref name="FotJ: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
**Galactic Alliance Chief of State [[Natasi Daala]] responds to these revolts with overwhelming and brutal force, leading to Imperial withdrawal from the Unification process.<ref name="FotJ: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
**The [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] leads a [[Plan Delta|coup]] to overthrow Daala, ending her reign and leading to her imprisonment. Luke Skywalker's exile is ended.<ref name="FotJ: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>
**The dark side entity known as [[Abeloth]] manipulates the Galactic Senate to elect [[Rokari Kem]], whom it possesses, as Chief of State. Chief of State Kem is used as a figurehead for Abeloth and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] to attempt to rule the galaxy.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
**[[Sinkhole Station]] is destroyed.<ref name="FotJ: Allies" />
**At the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|Liberation of Coruscant]], the Jedi Order defeats the Lost Tribe of Sith and Abeloth. [[Wynn Dorvan]] is elected as Chief of State in the aftermath.
**[[Tahiri Veila]] returns to the Jedi Order.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
**The Jedi Order is commanded by the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] to leave Coruscant. The Jedi Temple is abandoned and the Order relocates to the academy on [[Shedu Maad]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
**[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] helps Daala [[Escape from the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|escape]] from the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], as she begins a campaign of revenge and conquest, intending to conquer the galaxy. The Imperial Remnant, led by Jagged Fel, declares war on Daala's forces.<ref name="FotJ: Conviction" />
**[[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] joins the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="FotJ: Conviction" />
**[[Jagged Fel]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] are [[Wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo|married]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />

*[[45 ABY]]
**The [[Fel Empire]] is founded. {{Circa}}<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
**[[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] attempts a takeover of the entire galactic economy.<ref name="Crucible" />

*[[55 ABY]]
**The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] polemicist and partisan [[Lenang O'Pali/Legends|Lenang O'Pali]] publishes ''[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective]]'', detailing [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|role]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[81 ABY]]
**The [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Thull Kabanard]] publishes ''[[Portraits in Late Galactic History]]'', detailing the course of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[92 ABY]]
**The [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|MC140 ''Scythe''-class battlecruiser]] is first deployed in service.<ref name="Warfare" />

*[[104 ABY]]
**[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] tells the [[Keeper of the Whills]] about the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family's]] history through the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TMOSWROTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>
**The ''[[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]]'' publishes ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', an article on the long history of [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]].<ref name="Tinker Tailor" />

*After 104 ABY
**Tweleve paintings are created: ''[[Alderaan Refugees]]'', ''[[AT-AT Villa]]'', ''[[Bad Pet]]'', ''[[Bridgeworld Lost]]'', ''[[Death Star Drydock]]'', ''[[Executor Executes]]'', ''[[Green Coruscant]]'', ''[[Hunting Overlook]]'', ''[[Jedi Museum]]'', ''[[Mygeeto Burns]]'', ''[[Reclaimed Wreck]]'' and ''[[Utapau Surrenders]]''.<ref name="Celstia Galactica Photografica">"[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]" was included in ''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 4]]'', which describes the stories it contains as taking place more than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. That film took place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', meaning that all [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] in "Celestia Galactica Photografica" must have been created after [[104 ABY]].</ref>

*[[122 ABY]]
**The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], Jedi Order and [[Yuuzhan Vong]] complete a [[Ossus Project|successful terraforming]] of the war devastated planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. As a result, Yuuzhan Vong terraforming technology is implemented on a hundred other planets. The [[One Sith]] sabotages the program, causing renewed hostility to the Yuuzhan Vong and distrust of the Jedi.<ref name="Legacy 0½">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0½|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0½]]</ref>

*[[127 ABY]]
**The [[Fel Empire]] starts a secession movement against the Alliance, in part due to the failure of the Ossus Project.<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>
**The Empire declares [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] on the Alliance, claiming violations of the [[Treaty of Anaxes]].<ref name="Legacy 0" />
**The Sith form an alliance with the Galactic Empire through the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]].<ref name="Legacy 0" />

*[[130 ABY]]
**The [[Sith–Imperial War|Sith-Imperial War]] comes to an end when the Galactic Alliance is defeated at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and its remaining territories are absorbed by the Empire which becomes the new galactic government. The Jedi Order is nearly destroyed during a [[Massacre at Ossus|massacre]] at [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], with [[Kol Skywalker]] as one of the casualties.<ref name="Legacy 0" />
**The [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] under Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] begins its campaign against the Empire.<ref name="Legacy 0½" />
**The [[One Sith]] turns against Emperor [[Roan Fel]] and his [[Imperial Knight]]s. [[Darth Krayt]] usurps the Imperial throne, though some parts of the Empire [[Empire-in-exile|remain loyal to Fel]].<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref>
**Beginning of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy 8: A">[[Legacy (2006) 8|''Legacy'' (2006) 8]]</ref>

*[[137 ABY]]
**The [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] is [[Destruction of Ossus Jedi Academy|destroyed]] by the [[One Sith]].<ref name="Legacy 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>
**The [[Genocide on Dac]] takes place.<ref name="Legacy 22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>
**[[Cade Skywalker]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and descendant of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], lives in self-imposed exile from the Jedi. He begins to rediscover his destiny as a Jedi Knight and as a member of the Skywalker family, and rises to fight the new Sith. He embarks on a series of adventures aboard his starship [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']].
**Darth Krayt is killed by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)]] after the [[Battle on Had Abbadon]], then resurrected on Korriban.<ref name="Legacy 31">[[Legacy (2006) 31|''Legacy'' (2006) 31]]</ref>
**[[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and Fel [[Empire-in-exile|Empire-in-Exile]] forces unite against [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].
**The spirit of [[Darth Andeddu]] is destroyed for the final time.<ref name="Legacy 27">[[Legacy (2006) 27|''Legacy'' (2006) 27]]</ref>

*[[138 ABY]]
**Darth Krayt kills Darth Wyyrlok (III) and regains control of the Empire. The [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith Trooper]] project is unveiled.<ref name="Legacy War 1">[[Legacy — War 1|''Legacy — War'' 1]]</ref>
**The [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|Hidden Jedi Temple falls]], though many of its defenders are able to evacuate.<ref name="Legacy War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref>
**Jedi, Galactic Alliance Remnant, and Empire-in-Exile forces [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|launch an assault on Coruscant]], defeating the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Krayt Empire]]. Darth Krayt is killed for a final time by Cade Skywalker. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Roan Fel falls to the dark side and is killed by the [[Imperial Knight]]s.<ref name="Legacy War 5">[[Legacy — War 5|''Legacy — War'' 5]]</ref>
**[[Marasiah Fel]] becomes Empress.<ref name="Legacy War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>
**The [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], consisting of Admiral [[Gar Stazi]], Empress Fel, and Jedi Master [[K'Kruhk]], is formed.<ref name="Legacy War 6" />
**The One Sith decide on the new strategy of taking over governments planet by planet via infiltration.<ref name="Legacy War 6" />
**[[Darth Wredd's insurgency]] begins.<ref name="Legacy 1: PotFW,PI">[[Legacy (2013) 1|''Legacy'' (2013) 1]]</ref>
**[[Darth Luft]]'s operation to build a hidden Sith fleet in the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] discovered and [[Liberation of Mon Calamari Shipyards|destroyed]].<ref name="Legacy 9">[[Legacy (2013) 9|''Legacy'' (2013) 9]]</ref>
*[[139 ABY]]
**The [[Battle of the Floating World]] is fought. Many One Sith infiltrators from across the galaxy are slain.<ref name="Legacy Volume2">[[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 2|''Star Wars: Legacy'' Volume 2]]</ref>
**[[Darth Wredd]] is killed by [[Ania Solo]] and his insurgency ends.
*[[140 ABY]]
**[[Ania Solo]], [[Sauk]], [[AG-37]], and [[Jao Assam]] get involved in a firefight.
